title: Managed Backup: activation
content:
For Managed Backup, the activation basis governs contract activation.

## Policy clauses

The contract status is applied.

The contract approval state is approved.

Activate an approved application after provisioning evidence confirms the configured resources; record activation time from the fixed handling clock.

Refuse rejected or pending applications.

Setup is invoiced under lifecycle and bank-return fee rules when setup fee is positive; a waived setup fee creates no charge.

Repeating an activation of an already active contract is a read-only confirmation, not another activation.

## Authoritative evidence

Before contract activation, system records must establish this condition for the proposed action: The contract status is applied.

The evidence identifies Contract reference, Status. Match the action to that evidence by Contract reference; these references identify the same proposed business objects.

The recorded contract state for this action must be applied.

Before contract activation, system records must establish this condition for the proposed action: The contract approval state is approved.

The evidence identifies Contract reference, Contract approval state. Match the action to that evidence by Contract reference; these references identify the same proposed business objects.

The agent changes the approved contract from applied to active.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the stated entry basis?** The contract status is applied.

## Hypothetical case

For a hypothetical already active contract, a repeated activation is a read-only confirmation. It does not create another activation or another activation occurrence.

title: Managed Backup: signed application admission
content:
For Managed Backup, the signed application admission basis governs contract application registration.

## Policy clauses

The signed application request has an approved service review.

The customer signs and submits the application through a supported request channel.

Create the contract in applied status and date its application registration from the fixed handling clock, with no consumption or charge.

The requested tier supplies resource count limit; reject unsupported regions, unsupported currency, resource counts above that limit, and unapproved contract terms without a write.

The customer owns the signature; an agent cannot sign for them.

Entry gates are evaluated against the authoritative signed application attributes recorded for the proposed contract.

## Authoritative evidence

Before contract application registration, system records must establish this condition for the proposed action: The signed application request has an approved service review.

The evidence identifies Event reference, Customer request reference, Status, Decision. Match the action to that evidence by Event reference, Customer request reference; these references identify the same proposed business objects.

For each listed tier, contract approval must be approved, the resource count may not exceed the tier resource limit, and the region must be one of the tier regional usage entries.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the stated entry basis?** The signed application request has an approved service review.

## Hypothetical case

In a hypothetical application, the customer has signed but the service review is pending. The application cannot be created on the strength of the signature alone; unapproved terms are rejected without a write.

title: Managed Backup: independent resource scopes
content:
For Managed Backup, the independent resource scopes basis governs contract application registration.

## Policy clauses

The signed resource scope is not already represented by a nonclosed contract.

Multiple independent resource scopes may be held.

Use external source reference as the signed resource-scope key.

Count all nonclosed holdings of this category for the same customer; refuse creation if the count would exceed 24.

A repeated signed application with the same external resource scope reuses the existing contract rather than opening another.

## Authoritative evidence

Before contract application registration, system records must establish this condition for the proposed action: The signed resource scope is not already represented by a nonclosed contract.

The evidence identifies Contract reference, Customer reference, Status, External source reference. Match the action to that evidence by Contract reference, Customer reference; these references identify the same proposed business objects.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the stated entry basis?** The signed resource scope is not already represented by a nonclosed contract.

## Hypothetical case

A hypothetical customer has 24 nonclosed contracts and proposes a new independent scope. Creation would exceed the permitted count and is refused. A repeated signed application for an existing scope instead reuses its contract.

title: Managed Backup: portfolio usage eligibility
content:
For Managed Backup, the portfolio usage eligibility basis governs charge posting.

## Policy clauses

Use posted portfolio usage subtotal before discount and tax to select the portfolio discount.

Combine only holdings of this category owned by the same customer with the same legal billing entity and source period, even if some have since closed.

No cross-entity or cross-category spending counts.

The threshold comparison is inclusive.

Portfolio discount applies only to primary service usage and only if no higher-priority price applies; it is neither a cash credit nor a deduction from ancillary service fees.

The source period, a UTC calendar month; customer and legal billing entity match the proposed charge. Sum posted primary meter quantities net of meter reversal by holding, multiply each interval by its applicable standard tier primary unit rate and region factor without any discount or tax, and sum across this category. Exclude ancillary meters and never sum already discounted invoices.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the stated entry basis?** Use posted portfolio usage subtotal before discount and tax to select the portfolio discount.

## Hypothetical case

In a hypothetical source month, the qualifying portfolio subtotal equals its applicable threshold. The threshold condition is met. Spending in another legal billing entity cannot supply any part of that subtotal.

title: Managed Backup: capacity amendment
content:
For Managed Backup, the capacity amendment basis governs contract amendment.

## Policy clauses

The contract status is active or suspended.

The source amendment request is approved and customer-authorized.

The customer files a signed amendment request before the agent applies the approved attributes.

The request external source reference identifies the signed amendment; its related approved review carries the affected exact values and effective service interval start.

Request and review events preserve those effective attributes.

Keep status unchanged, use the new tier only for service intervals beginning at the request effective time, and retain old tier and effective price on earlier meter and invoice records.

Refuse any change above resource count limit or when completed amendment count has reached monthly accepted amendment limit.

Completed amendment requests count once; pending, rejected or cancelled requests do not change the holding.

Signed commitments keep their recorded expiration and remaining contractual liability unless the signed amendment explicitly replaces them.

## Authoritative evidence

Before contract amendment, system records must establish this condition for the proposed action: The contract status is active or suspended.

The evidence identifies Contract reference, Status. Match the action to that evidence by Contract reference; these references identify the same proposed business objects.

The recorded contract state for this action must be active or suspended.

Before contract amendment, system records must establish this condition for the proposed action: The source amendment request is approved and customer-authorized.

The evidence identifies Event reference, Status, Customer request reference, Source business subtype. Match the action to that evidence by Event reference, Customer request reference; these references identify the same proposed business objects.

UTC calendar month containing the fixed handling time. Count completed request events of source business subtype amendment for this holding; cancelled and rejected requests do not count.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the stated entry basis?** The contract status is active or suspended.

## Hypothetical case

A hypothetical approved amendment becomes effective at a recorded instant. A service interval beginning before that instant retains its earlier tier; one beginning at that instant uses the new tier. Neither branch changes contract status.

title: Managed Backup: backup and restore meter calculation
content:
For Managed Backup, the backup and restore meter calculation basis governs charge posting, supplemental meter recording, nonfinancial service recording.

## Policy clauses

The reference protected capacity in GB defines a price band rather than included protection.

Primary usage measures actual protected GB-month at primary unit rate.

Retained backup storage bills retained GB-month beyond included storage multiple times the primary protected quantity at excess backup storage rate.

Ingestion uses incremental ingestion rate per incremental GB; remote copy transfer uses remote copy transfer rate per copied GB; immutable storage uses immutable copy storage rate per GB-month.

The customer chooses standard or rapid restore for a source restore request: standard restore charges restored GB at standard restore rate only after the included number of completed standard restores in that calendar month, and rapid restore always uses rapid restore rate.

Restore requests are distinct by source reference and completion time; an uncompleted restore has no usage charge.

Export uses export processing rate per processed GB.

A customer-selected immutable copy cannot be disposed before its recorded lock expiration; the default retention for ordinary copies is default ordinary-copy retention period.

Early deletion retention billing charges remaining minimum charged immutable retention period less authoritative age in calendar days, floored at zero, times deleted GB and immutable copy storage rate divided by actual dates in the deletion month.

This retention billing applies only where an allowed policy retention reduction deletes a copy after its lock expires; it never authorizes breaking an immutable lock.

Actual configured retention and age are recorded separately.

For every ancillary meter, multiply the nonincluded measured quantity by its selected rate, then round the net line using monetary decimal precision and rounding convention and tax under tax rules.

An allowance is consumed chronologically by service interval start then original source reference within the named holding and UTC period; reversal of its source returns only that source allocation.

Source subtype supplemental identifies these amounts so the primary discount policy does not apply.

Completed service records prove nonfinancial entitlements; unknown meter codes or units are not covered by policy instead of guessed prices.

These calculations never authorize an unapproved customer-only action.

For included capacities denominated in GB-month, contact-month or package-month, prorate the capacity by actual active interval seconds divided by actual seconds in its UTC month before comparing measured quantity.

Category-specific primary inclusions replace the generic included primary quantity where expressly named; they are not added twice.

A mandatory minimum fee is a pricing minimum, not a second charge.

The unrounded ancillary subtotal is the positive remainder of measured quantity after the applied inclusion, floored at zero, multiplied by the selected ancillary unit rate.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the stated entry basis?** The reference protected capacity in GB defines a price band rather than included protection.

## Hypothetical case

Suppose a hypothetical permitted retention reduction deletes an immutable copy after its recorded lock expires. The minimum charged retention is 18 days, authoritative age is 12 days, deleted quantity is 10 GB, storage rate is USD 0.06 per GB-month, and the deletion month contains 30 dates. The unrounded retention amount is USD 0.12: the remaining 6 days are multiplied by 10 GB and USD 0.06, then divided by 30. If authoritative age instead reaches 18 days, the remaining retention amount is zero. These hypothetical values neither define tier rates nor authorize deletion before lock expiry.

title: Managed Backup: payment allocation
content:
For Managed Backup, the payment allocation basis governs payment allocation.

## Policy clauses

The bank record confirms the remittance as completed.

Record only a bank-confirmed remittance using an accepted payment rail and the amount actually received in currency.

Customer consent to dispose of funds belongs to the customer; the agent only allocates a payment already confirmed by the bank.

Apply an explicitly referenced invoice first; if the remittance omits allocation, use default remittance allocation order, sorting invoice issue time then original source reference within the same customer and billing entity.

Split across exact source invoice lines, never across legal billing entities.

Each allocation is a separate negative payment amount linked to its original charge; any residual is an unallocated overpayment linked to the remittance reference.

A repeated remittance reference and allocation target returns the existing posting.

No receipt is inferred from a customer promise, and rejected or pending payments make no posting.

## Authoritative evidence

Before payment allocation, system records must establish this condition for the proposed action: The bank record confirms the remittance as completed.

The evidence identifies Event reference, Status, External source reference, Method. Match the action to that evidence by Event reference; these references identify the same proposed business objects.

All posted financial events through the fixed handling time. Sum signed amount for charge, debit adjustment, payment return and refund together with negative amount for payment and credit, grouped by holding. The balance is derived from those postings rather than maintained independently.

The receivable is signed customer debt in USD. Charges, upward adjustments, returned payments and refunds increase debt; payments and credits decrease it.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the stated entry basis?** The bank record confirms the remittance as completed.

## Hypothetical case

A hypothetical bank-confirmed remittance of USD 50 allocates USD 35 to an exact original charge. The allocation is a negative payment of USD 35, and the residual USD 15 is an unallocated overpayment linked to that remittance.

title: Managed Backup: Enterprise Support combination
content:
For Managed Backup, the Enterprise Support combination basis governs charge posting.

## Policy clauses

A current Northbridge Enterprise Support holding for the same customer and billing entity provides assisted invoice explanation, but does not itself reduce this category price or waive debt.

An approved negotiated rate is a contract-specific override; the presence of a paid support holding makes assisted negotiated-amendment intake available through support as well as portal and API.

Without that combination the signed amendment is submitted through portal or API.

A promotional primary-price entitlement is suppressed wherever a commitment price covers the same quantity, and no benefit from an unrelated category is stacked.

The combination changes only request-channel eligibility, not approval authority.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the stated entry basis?** A current Northbridge Enterprise Support holding for the same customer and billing entity provides assisted invoice explanation, but does not itself reduce this category price or waive debt.

## Hypothetical case

In a hypothetical portfolio, a current paid Enterprise Support holding belongs to a different legal billing entity. It does not satisfy the same-entity combination for assisted negotiated-amendment intake.

title: Managed Backup: billing correction
content:
For Managed Backup, the billing correction basis governs credit posting, upward adjustment.

## Policy clauses

For source business subtype correction, the source charge has an approved review with decision incorrect.

This gate is inapplicable to other source business subtype values.

Correct an erroneous charge to the approved review pretax amount plus tax amount, following tax rules.

Compare that corrected gross amount with the source original gross amount less cumulative correction credits plus cumulative debit adjustments; do not include service-credit concessions in this correction comparison.

Credit the positive overcharge, debit the positive undercharge, and make no write when equal.

A credit amount is negative and its net and tax components preserve the source proportions except an approved tax correction.

An upward correction carries positive amount.

Return the existing adjustment when the reviewed target has already been achieved.

No cash refund is implicit in an invoice correction.

Link original source reference to the original charge and linked evidence reference to the approved review, never to a broad invoice containing several lines.

Use cumulative gross correction amount from source-specific correction and service-credit totals for the correction comparison; cumulative pretax service-credit amount never changes the approved corrected billing target.

## Authoritative evidence

Before credit posting, upward adjustment, system records must establish this condition for the proposed action: For source business subtype correction, the source charge has an approved review with decision incorrect. This gate is inapplicable to other source business subtype values.

The evidence identifies Event reference, Original source reference, Linked evidence reference, Status, Decision. Match the action to that evidence by Event reference, Original source reference, Linked evidence reference; these references identify the same proposed business objects.

All posted credit and debit adjustment events through the fixed handling time for the exact original source reference. For the exact original charge reference, report cumulative gross correction amount as absolute correction credit amount less debit-adjustment amount, and cumulative pretax service-credit amount as absolute pretax amount of service-credit postings. Keep these two named components separate; tax is included only in cumulative gross correction amount, and unrelated source charges never enter either component.

The approved corrected gross target is the sum of the approved corrected pretax amount and corrected tax amount.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the stated entry basis?** For source business subtype correction, the source charge has an approved review with decision incorrect.

## Hypothetical case

Suppose a hypothetical original gross charge is USD 100, prior gross correction credits total USD 20, and prior upward adjustments total USD 5. Its corrected comparison amount is USD 85. An approved target of USD 70 requires a further credit of USD 15. A separate service-credit concession does not change this calculation. If the approved target were USD 85, no new adjustment would be made.

title: Managed Backup: lifecycle and returned payment charges
content:
For Managed Backup, the lifecycle and returned payment charges basis governs charge posting.

## Policy clauses

This fee branch applies only to setup, resumption, termination and bank-return fee source business subtype.

Charge setup fee once for an activated holding, resumption fee per distinct completed restoration, on-demand termination fee for on-demand exit, and returned payment fee per completed bank return.

An unexpired commitment exit instead bills the recorded remaining contractual liability in USD as its termination liability.

Copy the exact source transition, customer authorization or bank notice reference; do not use a primary meter as fee evidence.

A zero fee is waived without a financial event.

The fee amount is the selected policy amount or recorded signed liability, rounded using monetary decimal precision and rounding convention, then taxed under tax rules.

The primary-usage branch of primary usage pricing rules and its posted source meter evidence gate apply only to source business subtype primary; supplemental charges use the category meter policy.

Already billed source occurrence and fee subtype make repetition read-only.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the stated entry basis?** This fee branch applies only to setup, resumption, termination and bank-return fee source business subtype.

## Hypothetical case

For a hypothetical completed restoration whose applicable resumption fee is zero, no financial fee event is created. Repeating the same already billed source occurrence and fee subtype is read-only even if presented under another handling attempt.

title: Managed Backup: incident registration
content:
For Managed Backup, the incident registration basis governs incident registration.

## Policy clauses

Operations record the closed incident, affected holding, exact incident external source reference, official incident closure time, cause, measured duration in hours and recorded availability percentage from the official operational report.

No customer statement substitutes for the report.

Scheduled maintenance, customer changes and upstream-customer events remain visible with their cause code even though outage credit rules exclude them.

Incident registration itself never creates a credit or changes contract status.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the stated entry basis?** Operations record the closed incident, affected holding, exact incident external source reference, official incident closure time, cause, measured duration in hours and recorded availability percentage from the official operational report.

## Hypothetical case

A hypothetical incident report records scheduled maintenance. Its cause remains visible on the registered incident; registration itself changes neither the receivable nor the contract state.

title: Managed Backup: invoice source identity
content:
For Managed Backup, the invoice source identity basis governs charge posting.

## Policy clauses

No posted charge exists for the same source event, meter, source business subtype, effective price branch and billing period.

Group service charges by invoice grouping basis.

Billing periods follow billing cycle in billing timezone, beginning at the first instant of the first date and ending exclusively at the first instant of the next month.

For measured usage, invoice only services whose interval has ended; lifecycle fees instead require their source occurrence to be completed; use the posted authoritative source records.

Set invoice issue time to the fixed handling time.

Carry forward a positive grouped subtotal below minimum invoice amount rather than issuing an invoice; zero-rated usage stays visible as a meter and receives no monetary charge.

A source charge already posted for the same source event, meter, quantity component and invoice period is returned without another charge.

The fixed source reference and source business subtype distinguish primary, supplemental, setup, termination, resumption and return-fee components.

## Authoritative evidence

Before charge posting, system records must establish this condition for the proposed action: No posted charge exists for the same source event, meter, source business subtype, effective price branch and billing period.

The evidence identifies Event reference, Original source reference, Meter code, Source business subtype, Effective price branch, Period, Event type, Status. Match the action to that evidence by Original source reference; these references identify the same proposed business objects.

A separately recorded charge counts as a duplicate when it is posted and matches the source, meter, source business subtype, effective price branch and period; distinct external references do not replace this source-component test.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the stated entry basis?** No posted charge exists for the same source event, meter, source business subtype, effective price branch and billing period.

## Hypothetical case

A hypothetical posted charge already matches the same source, meter, business subtype, effective price branch and period. A changed external invoice reference does not create a new billable component. The existing charge is returned.

title: Managed Backup: meter evidence and rounding
content:
For Managed Backup, the meter evidence and rounding basis governs primary meter recording, meter reversal, supplemental meter recording.

## Policy clauses

The authoritative export confirms the resource interval and the measured quantity.

Meters originate in the provider resource export.

Primary meter quantities use primary protected GB-month unit; a meter is positive and a meter reversal is the negative of the exact erroneous source quantity, capped by the source quantity not already reversed.

Keep original interval, region, configuration and source reference.

Billing of actual usage overage permits measured quantities above included primary quantity; no service entitlement is invented by a meter write.

Round measured quantities to meter quantity decimal precision using rounding convention, apply minimum primary quantity and round positive billable primary quantities upward to a whole primary meter increment.

Stopped or suspended service accrues no primary running usage, but real retained storage and other supplemental services remain billable through supplemental meter.

A rejected or cancelled source is not a billable meter.

Repeated exports with the same resource, meter, interval and correction reference are read-only confirmations.

## Authoritative evidence

Before primary meter recording, meter reversal, supplemental meter recording, system records must establish this condition for the proposed action: The authoritative export confirms the resource interval and the measured quantity.

The evidence identifies Event reference, External source reference, Service interval start, Service interval end, Quantity. Match the action to that evidence by Event reference; these references identify the same proposed business objects.

Primary physical consumption is the net of positive primary meters and negative meter reversals, kept by original source service period for billing.

The measured primary quantity basis is the greater of the measured quantity and the applicable minimum primary quantity; the stated precision and upward-increment rules still apply.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the stated entry basis?** The authoritative export confirms the resource interval and the measured quantity.

## Hypothetical case

Suppose a hypothetical erroneous source quantity is 8 protected GB-month and 3 protected GB-month has already been reversed. At most 5 protected GB-month remains reversible. Reversing that remainder contributes a negative quantity of 5 protected GB-month and preserves the original interval.

title: Managed Backup: primary usage pricing
content:
For Managed Backup, the primary usage pricing basis governs charge posting.

## Policy clauses

This policy and its gate apply only to primary usage source business subtype; category-specific primary pricing overrides expressly stated in category meter rules take priority.

For source business subtype primary, the source meter is posted and identifies the billed resource interval.

This gate is inapplicable to other source business subtype values.

Use the tier recorded for each source service interval.

Read primary unit rate and regional usage multipliers for primary usage.

Allocate included primary quantity across primary meter sources of the same holding and period in service interval start then original source reference order; prorate it by actual active UTC seconds divided by actual seconds in that UTC calendar month.

Only the positive quantity beyond the remaining included allowance is charged.

Allocate monthly committed primary quantity in that same order, splitting covered and uncovered primary quantities into distinguishable invoice lines.

The holding commitment must cover the entire source interval to receive commitment discount fractions; a boundary-crossing interval is split at the recorded commitment boundary.

For every quantity component choose the first applicable item in price selection priority: an approved negotiated rate when approved negotiated pricing is permitted, then the committed fraction, then a recorded eligible promotion from campaign pricing channels, then portfolio eligibility, then standard.

The negotiated rate replaces the primary unit rate before applying the region factor and receives no further discount.

Promotions and reservations are mutually exclusive.

Round the final service subtotal using monetary decimal precision and rounding convention after quantity multiplication, then apply tax rules.

No discount applies to taxes, license fees, standalone supplemental services or previously issued credits.

Record effective price branch for each split quantity branch; it is part of the invoice-line identity.

Do not apply a billing-period portfolio discount to a partial source interval before the full source period is closed.

## Authoritative evidence

Before charge posting, system records must establish this condition for the proposed action: For source business subtype primary, the source meter is posted and identifies the billed resource interval. This gate is inapplicable to other source business subtype values.

The evidence identifies Event reference, Status, Service interval start, Service interval end. Match the action to that evidence by Event reference; these references identify the same proposed business objects.

The unrounded service subtotal uses the positive remainder of measured quantity after its allocated inclusion, floored at zero, multiplied by the effective unit rate and by one less the selected discount fraction. The regional and negotiated-rate basis and each separate price branch are preserved in that effective pricing.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the stated entry basis?** This policy and its gate apply only to primary usage source business subtype; category-specific primary pricing overrides expressly stated in category meter rules take priority.

## Hypothetical case

A hypothetical source has a billable component of 10 protected GB-month, an approved negotiated unit rate of USD 0.07 and a regional multiplier of 1.2. The unrounded service subtotal is USD 0.84. Even if a campaign is recorded, no further campaign discount acts on this negotiated amount.

title: Managed Backup: cash refund eligibility
content:
For Managed Backup, the cash refund eligibility basis governs cash refund.

## Policy clauses

The customer-authorized refund request and completed original payment refer to the same holding and source payment.

The customer files an exact refund authorization; the agent refunds a confirmed overpayment only to the method and destination of its original payment.

Available refund is the smaller of the negative net receivable magnitude and original payment principal less prior returns and refunds linked to that payment.

A requested amount exceeding that limit is refused, not silently reduced.

Use permitted refund methods, require at least minimum cash refund, and record a positive receivable delta for cash paid out.

A smaller positive balance remains on account.

Refunds require no active service contract and remain possible after closure.

Repetition of the same request and source payment returns the existing refund.

A third-party destination or unconfirmed payment is refused.

## Authoritative evidence

Before cash refund, system records must establish this condition for the proposed action: The customer-authorized refund request and completed original payment refer to the same holding and source payment.

The evidence identifies Event reference, Customer request reference, Original source reference, Status, Contract reference. Match the action to that evidence by Event reference, Customer request reference, Original source reference, Contract reference; these references identify the same proposed business objects.

The balance-based maximum is the greater of zero and the negative of the net receivable. The source-payment remainder can impose the smaller available refund.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the stated entry basis?** The customer-authorized refund request and completed original payment refer to the same holding and source payment.

## Hypothetical case

Suppose a hypothetical confirmed overpayment magnitude is USD 80 and the original payment principal remaining after its linked returns and refunds is USD 55. The available refund is USD 55. A request for USD 60 is refused rather than reduced. This comparison does not waive the refund minimum or original-destination conditions.

title: Managed Backup: customer request registration
content:
For Managed Backup, the customer request registration basis governs customer request registration.

## Policy clauses

Only the customer may file or cancel an authorization, claim or disposal request.

Preserve the exact external source reference and the narrowest original source reference.

Set notice filing time and occurrence time to the fixed handling clock and status pending on filing; cancellation is a new request event with status cancelled linked to the original request.

An unsupported channel is refused.

A repeated identical request reference returns the existing event.

Filing a request never confirms a system approval or changes an accounting balance.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the stated entry basis?** Only the customer may file or cancel an authorization, claim or disposal request.

## Hypothetical case

A hypothetical filing supplies an identical request reference to a request already recorded. The existing event is returned; this repetition does not create system approval or change debt.

title: Managed Backup: returned remittance principal
content:
For Managed Backup, the returned remittance principal basis governs bank return recording.

## Policy clauses

The completed bank return notice refers to the exact original posted payment.

The bank return must identify the exact posted payment.

Restore the returned principal as a positive amount, up to the original payment amount not already returned.

Copy its method, customer, billing entity and currency.

A partial return uses the distinct bank notice external source reference.

A duplicate bank notice produces no new write.

Any returned payment fee is a separately identifiable return-fee charge under lifecycle and bank-return fee rules, never hidden in returned principal; a waived fee produces no fee posting.

## Authoritative evidence

Before bank return recording, system records must establish this condition for the proposed action: The completed bank return notice refers to the exact original posted payment.

The evidence identifies Event reference, Original source reference, Status, External source reference. Match the action to that evidence by Event reference, Original source reference; these references identify the same proposed business objects.

Returned principal is the absolute magnitude of the returned payment amount, subject to the unreversed original-payment cap.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the stated entry basis?** The completed bank return notice refers to the exact original posted payment.

## Hypothetical case

A hypothetical original payment principal is USD 90 and prior returns total USD 25. The remaining principal available for return is USD 65. A distinct completed bank notice may identify a partial return within that remainder; a duplicated bank notice creates no additional return.

title: Managed Backup: authoritative source review
content:
For Managed Backup, the authoritative source review basis governs source review.

## Policy clauses

The source event and the evidence record identify the same holding and narrowest business object.

A service accountant reviews one precise source event against its authoritative export, contract terms, bank notice, tax record or incident record.

Record decision correct or incorrect for a billing review, and eligible or ineligible for an outage claim; status approved means the review is complete and authoritative, not that a credit necessarily follows.

Record corrected pretax amount and tax amount for incorrect billing, or approved credit amount for an eligible outage after applying outage credit rules.

A rejected review cannot authorize money movement.

The customer may provide a locator but cannot dictate an official decision.

Repeating the same source and request review returns the existing decision; materially new evidence is a distinct review linked through linked evidence reference.

Review alone books no money.

## Authoritative evidence

Before source review, system records must establish this condition for the proposed action: The source event and the evidence record identify the same holding and narrowest business object.

The evidence identifies Event reference, Original source reference, Linked evidence reference, Contract reference. Match the action to that evidence by Event reference, Original source reference, Linked evidence reference, Contract reference; these references identify the same proposed business objects.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the stated entry basis?** The source event and the evidence record identify the same holding and narrowest business object.

## Hypothetical case

A hypothetical billing review is approved with decision correct. Approved status makes the review authoritative; it does not mean that the source billing was incorrect or that a credit follows.

title: Managed Backup: outage credit entitlement
content:
For Managed Backup, the outage credit entitlement basis governs customer request registration, source review, credit posting.

## Policy clauses

For an outage service credit financial posting, an approved review has decision eligible and positive approved credit amount for the exact source charge; this gate does not constrain filing or reviewing the request.

For an outage service credit request being filed, the outage claim is filed no later than outage claim filing period after the official incident closes.

For a newly filed claim, fixed handling time is its notice filing time; the request is recorded immediately.

Later review and credit use that recorded notice filing time to evaluate the same boundary, so a timely request does not expire while awaiting review.

Add outage claim filing period UTC calendar dates to official incident closure time, preserving its time of day; calendar dates are counted without substituting business days or elapsed-hour periods.

Equality at the deadline qualifies; a later claim is rejected without a credit.

The provider incident must be completed, with cause outside excluded outage causes.

Availability at or above availability target percentage gives no credit.

Below the target choose the first descending availability credit bands entry whose minimum is no greater than the recorded availability percentage.

Multiply the original source charge pretax amount by that fraction; subtract the cumulative pretax service-credit amount component of prior credits for that exact source, and cap total service credits at cumulative outage credit cap fraction of that original net amount.

Floor the additional credit at zero and round with monetary decimal precision and rounding convention.

Apply the original tax component proportionately.

A review writes its nonnegative approved result; a financial credit writes the negative approved amount only after that approved review exists.

This service-credit branch applies only to source business subtype outage service credit; billing correction rules apply only to source business subtype correction.

Excluded incidents, ineligible reviews and zero remaining entitlement result in no financial write.

A request for consequential-loss compensation is not covered.

A service-credit financial posting requires an approved review with decision eligible and positive approved credit amount; the request and incident alone cannot authorize the financial posting.

## Authoritative evidence

Before customer request registration, system records must establish this condition for the proposed action: For an outage service credit request being filed, the outage claim is filed no later than outage claim filing period after the official incident closes.

The evidence identifies Event reference, Official incident closure time, Notice filing time. Match the action to that evidence by Event reference; these references identify the same proposed business objects.

Add outage claim filing period UTC calendar dates to official incident closure time, preserving its time of day; calendar dates are counted without substituting business days or elapsed-hour periods. The comparison uses the fixed handling clock and includes equality at the boundary.

Before credit posting, system records must establish this condition for the proposed action: For an outage service credit financial posting, an approved review has decision eligible and positive approved credit amount for the exact source charge; this gate does not constrain filing or reviewing the request.

The evidence identifies Event reference, Original source reference, Status, Decision, Approved credit amount. Match the action to that evidence by Original source reference; these references identify the same proposed business objects.

The cumulative pretax service-credit ceiling is the original source pretax amount multiplied by its applicable credit cap fraction.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the stated entry basis?** For an outage service credit financial posting, an approved review has decision eligible and positive approved credit amount for the exact source charge; this gate does not constrain filing or reviewing the request.

## Hypothetical case

In a hypothetical claim, filing exactly at the incident closure time advanced by the applicable number of UTC calendar dates meets the deadline. Filing at a later instant fails it. A timely filing remains timely when the review occurs after that deadline, because review uses the recorded filing time. These timing results alone do not authorize a financial credit.

title: Managed Backup: tax calculation
content:
For Managed Backup, the tax calculation basis governs charge posting, credit posting, upward adjustment.

## Policy clauses

The applicable tax classification has an approved system review.

Use the source contract tax treatment reviewed at the service date and tax treatment rates.

Apply tax to the final rounded net service amount; round tax separately using monetary decimal precision and rounding convention.

For a correction or credit use the original charge tax basis unless an approved tax-error review supplies the corrected treatment.

Tax credits have negative tax amount; charges and upward adjustments have positive tax amount.

Unsupported tax jurisdictions are not covered by policy, not assumed exempt.

Sum net subtotal and signed tax to obtain the financial amount.

A verified exemption overrides the ordinary taxable rate; there is no stacking of tax treatments.

## Authoritative evidence

Before charge posting, credit posting, upward adjustment, system records must establish this condition for the proposed action: The applicable tax classification has an approved system review.

The evidence identifies Contract reference, Tax review state, Tax treatment. Match the action to that evidence by Contract reference; these references identify the same proposed business objects.

The gross financial amount is the sum of its signed pretax and tax components.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the stated entry basis?** The applicable tax classification has an approved system review.

## Hypothetical case

For a hypothetical rounded net charge of USD 20 and separately rounded positive tax of USD 1.60, the financial amount is USD 21.60. For a hypothetical credit with pretax amount negative USD 20 and tax negative USD 1.60, the financial amount is negative USD 21.60.

title: Managed Backup: withdrawal and termination
content:
For Managed Backup, the withdrawal and termination basis governs application withdrawal, active-contract closure, suspended-contract closure.

## Policy clauses

The customer has filed the exact resource-disposal authorization for this contract.

Only the customer may withdraw an application or terminate their provisioned resources.

An applied contract can be withdrawn without any setup, usage or termination charge.

For active or suspended contracts, record closure date from the fixed handling clock and stop running primary meters at the exact customer-confirmed close time.

Accrued usage and actual retained-resource charges remain payable; closing never erases receivables or credits.

On-demand termination fee applies to an on-demand exit under lifecycle and bank-return fee rules.

If a signed commitment remains unexpired and permission to forgive an unexpired commitment on customer termination is false, invoice its recorded remaining contractual liability in USD as a distinct termination component, without also charging future usage against that same liability.

No new usage begins after closure; existing financial corrections, collection and refunds remain possible.

Repeating the same closed-resource confirmation has no further effect.

Before closing, the signed termination schedule supplies the remaining contractual liability in USD; that liability is zero when no unbilled commitment liability remains.

A positive recorded liability necessarily triggers the distinct termination charge using the disposal request as its original source reference; closure and that one invoice entry complete the event chain.

## Authoritative evidence

Before application withdrawal, active-contract closure, suspended-contract closure, system records must establish this condition for the proposed action: The customer has filed the exact resource-disposal authorization for this contract.

The evidence identifies Contract reference, Customer request reference, Original source reference. Match the action to that evidence by Contract reference, Customer request reference, Original source reference; these references identify the same proposed business objects.

The customer performs withdrawal from applied to closed, or closure from active or suspended to closed.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the stated entry basis?** The customer has filed the exact resource-disposal authorization for this contract.

## Hypothetical case

In a hypothetical withdrawal, the contract is still applied. The customer may withdraw it without setup, usage or termination charges. In a separate hypothetical closure with positive recorded unbilled commitment liability, that liability requires its distinct termination entry using the disposal request as source.

title: Managed Backup: service resumption
content:
For Managed Backup, the service resumption basis governs contract resumption.

## Policy clauses

The contract status is suspended.

The contract payment restriction state is clear.

Restore a suspended holding after its official payment restriction clears; no customer promise substitutes for recorded clearance.

Set status active.

Bill resumption fee under lifecycle and bank-return fee rules only when positive, and preserve retained-resource history.

A contract already active needs no write; a closed contract requires a new signed application and cannot be resumed.

## Authoritative evidence

Before contract resumption, system records must establish this condition for the proposed action: The contract status is suspended.

The evidence identifies Contract reference, Status. Match the action to that evidence by Contract reference; these references identify the same proposed business objects.

The recorded contract state for this action must be suspended.

Before contract resumption, system records must establish this condition for the proposed action: The contract payment restriction state is clear.

The evidence identifies Contract reference, Payment restriction state. Match the action to that evidence by Contract reference; these references identify the same proposed business objects.

The agent changes the contract from suspended to active.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the stated entry basis?** The contract status is suspended.

## Hypothetical case

A hypothetical suspended contract has a customer promise to pay but its official restriction has not cleared. That promise does not satisfy the resumption condition. A closed contract cannot use resumption to become active.

title: Managed Backup: collection suspension
content:
For Managed Backup, the collection suspension basis governs contract suspension.

## Policy clauses

The contract status is active.

Collection suspension occurs no earlier than invoice payment maturity period plus collection suspension grace period after the source invoice is issued.

The contract payment restriction state is restricted and the source invoice retains unpaid principal.

Add invoice payment maturity period and then collection suspension grace period UTC calendar dates to invoice issue time, preserving its time of day; do not use business days or replace the anchor with contract activation.

Equality qualifies.

The source overdue invoice must retain a positive unpaid principal; a fully paid invoice cannot justify suspension.

Earlier handling sends an informational explanation without a status change.

An agent suspends active service only when official payment restriction state is restricted; ordinary billing disputes alone do not suspend service.

Retained ancillary resources can still produce actual supplemental usage.

Repeated handling of an already suspended contract makes no new transition.

## Authoritative evidence

Before contract suspension, system records must establish this condition for the proposed action: The contract status is active.

The evidence identifies Contract reference, Status. Match the action to that evidence by Contract reference; these references identify the same proposed business objects.

The recorded contract state for this action must be active.

Before contract suspension, system records must establish this condition for the proposed action: Collection suspension occurs no earlier than invoice payment maturity period plus collection suspension grace period after the source invoice is issued.

The evidence identifies Event reference, Invoice issue time. Match the action to that evidence by Event reference; these references identify the same proposed business objects.

Add invoice payment maturity period and then collection suspension grace period UTC calendar dates to invoice issue time, preserving its time of day; do not use business days or replace the anchor with contract activation. The comparison uses the fixed handling clock and includes equality at the boundary.

Before contract suspension, system records must establish this condition for the proposed action: The contract payment restriction state is restricted and the source invoice retains unpaid principal.

The evidence identifies Contract reference, Payment restriction state, Event reference, Amount. Match the action to that evidence by Contract reference, Event reference; these references identify the same proposed business objects.

The agent changes the contract from active to suspended.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the stated entry basis?** The contract status is active.

## Hypothetical case

In a hypothetical case, an active contract has an official payment restriction and the exact source invoice retains unpaid principal. At the invoice issue time advanced first by the maturity period and then by the grace period, the time condition is met. Immediately before that boundary, handling provides an explanation and leaves status unchanged.

title: Virtual Compute: assisted credit handling scope
content:
## Scope and evidence

Virtual Compute assisted credit scope. This policy applies only to the assisted primary correction package; link the original charge and its approved arithmetic review. The final target defined here supersedes the pre-concession review target, so achieving it completes the correction and implies no further correction. Within the assisted primary correction package, the same-entity active support combination determines the successive pricing adjustment and settlement concession described here in addition to request-channel eligibility; approval authority remains unchanged. A promotional primary-price entitlement remains suppressed wherever commitment pricing covers the same quantity; the two explicitly described same-entity support reductions are permitted successive adjustments, and no other cross-category benefit is stacked. For the primary credit action, evidence event reference and related evidence reference both identify the approved incorrect arithmetic review of the original primary charge.

title: Virtual Compute: assisted credit — credit difference
content:
## Calculation basis

Virtual Compute assisted credit — Credit the excess of original net plus signed correction adjustments over that final corrected net target as a negative amount, rounded half-up to two USD decimals; if there is no excess, make no credit write. The supported refund package requires an originally approved untaxed or verified-exempt source, so this credit has zero tax and amount equals pretax net amount.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for assisted credit — credit difference?**

Credit the excess of original net plus signed correction adjustments over that final corrected net target as a negative amount, rounded half-up to two USD decimals; if there is no excess, make no credit write. The supported refund package requires an originally approved untaxed or verified-exempt source, so this credit has zero tax and amount equals pretax net amount.

## Hypothetical case

Hypothetically, original net is 150 USD, prior signed adjustments are negative 20 USD, and the final target is 110 USD. The credit is negative 20.00 USD. At a target of 130 USD there is no credit posting.

title: Virtual Compute: assisted credit operation
content:
## Use and effect

Virtual Compute — Post a negative correction to one original primary invoice line. This decreases the contract receivable by the supplied amount and records the same untaxed net component; the returned reference identifies the posted credit.

## Invocation

credit_compute_line_adb33dcc is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call) by the agent.

## Parameter compute_holding_id

`compute_holding_id`: Id class — The compute contract reference for assisted credit, copied from find_compute_events, find_compute_holdings or find_customers results, or the preceding successful consent receipt as applicable.

## Parameter customer_id

`customer_id`: Id class — The customer profile reference for assisted credit, copied from find_compute_events, find_compute_holdings or find_customers results, or the preceding successful consent receipt as applicable.

## Parameter compute_event_id

`compute_event_id`: Id class — Identifier of the approved incorrect arithmetic review for the original primary charge, copied from its successful review receipt or find_compute_events; use the identical review reference supplied in related_event_id.

## Parameter source_event_id

`source_event_id`: Id class — Identifier of the original invoice line or payment being handled, copied from find_compute_events, find_compute_holdings or find_customers results, or the preceding successful consent receipt as applicable.

## Parameter related_event_id

`related_event_id`: Id class — Identifier of the related export or approved review, copied from find_compute_events, find_compute_holdings or find_customers results, or the preceding successful consent receipt as applicable.

## Parameter amount

`amount`: Fixed-format class — The signed financial amount in units of USD to two decimals, supplied as a decimal number already rounded half-up to two decimal places at calculation completion; stored to two decimals, with no empty value.

## Successful receipt

The successful string receipt identifies the newly recorded assisted credit by its new business event reference and confirms its posted registration and the business effect described above.

title: Virtual Compute: assisted review handling scope
content:
## Scope and evidence

Virtual Compute assisted review scope. This assisted primary correction review applies to a fully paid most recent primary line whose completed export and contracted terms are available synchronously; no missing external evidence can be manufactured. The selected holding has no tier change or commitment-boundary crossing within the source interval and no other primary holding in this billing entity during the target period. Record one approved incorrect review with pretax net amount equal to the revised net target; tax follows the original approved tax basis. Existing review of this exact request and source is read-only. This assisted export scope requires integral instance-hour source quantities, including any reversal quantities. Within the assisted primary correction package, the same-entity active support combination determines the successive pricing adjustment and settlement concession described here in addition to request-channel eligibility; approval authority remains unchanged. A promotional primary-price entitlement remains suppressed wherever commitment pricing covers the same quantity; the two explicitly described same-entity support reductions are permitted successive adjustments, and no other cross-category benefit is stacked. This assisted primary review does not handle partially covered source quantities: for a commitment with a term other than none, the recorded committed quantity remaining after earlier posted source allocations in the same holding and service period must cover the entire net quantity of the selected source, and the recorded commitment boundaries must contain its entire source interval. For the primary review action, evidence event reference identifies the unique completed review-subtype service-record packet whose original source reference is the original primary charge and whose related evidence reference is its exact provider export; the raw export itself does not occupy this packet role.

title: Virtual Compute: activation

title: Virtual Compute: agg usage
content:
## Retired clause 1

This former Virtual Compute handling clause is no longer in force: “Combine only holdings of this category owned by the same customer with the same legal billing entity and source period, even if some have since closed.” Its basis has been superseded.

## Retired clause 2

This former Virtual Compute handling clause is no longer in force: “Use the category pre-discount primary usage subtotal to select the portfolio discount.” Its basis has been superseded.

## Formal basis

Virtual Compute — No cross-entity or cross-category spending counts. The threshold comparison is inclusive. Portfolio discount applies only to primary service usage and only if no higher-priority price applies; it is neither a cash credit nor a deduction from ancillary service fees.

## Basis Q&A

Portfolio discount applies only to primary service usage and only if no higher-priority price applies;

The source period, a UTC calendar month; customer and legal billing entity match the proposed charge. Sum posted primary meter quantities net of meter reversal by holding, multiply each interval by its applicable standard tier standard unit rate and region factor without any discount or tax, and sum across this category. Exclude ancillary meters and never sum already discounted invoices.

title: Virtual Compute: amendment
content:
## Formal basis

Virtual Compute — The contract status is active or suspended. The source amendment request is approved and customer-authorized. The customer files a signed amendment request before the agent applies the approved attributes. The request external reference identifies the signed amendment; its related approved review carries the affected exact values and effective service interval start. Request and review events preserve those effective attributes. Keep status unchanged, use the new tier only for service intervals beginning at the request effective time, and retain old tier and effective price on earlier meter and invoice records. Refuse any change above maximum resource count or when the completed amendment count for the current UTC month has reached monthly amendment limit. Completed amendment requests count once; pending, rejected or cancelled requests do not change the holding. Signed commitments keep their recorded expiration and remaining contractual liability unless the signed amendment explicitly replaces them.

## Evidence — contract state

For amend, The contract status is active or suspended. Before this action, authoritative system records establish the condition using compute contract reference, status. Those records correlate to the current action by compute contract reference.

## Evidence — amendment approved

For amend, The source amendment request is approved and customer-authorized. Before this action, authoritative system records establish the condition using evidence event reference, status, customer request reference, source subtype. Those records correlate to the current action by evidence event reference, customer request reference.

## Recorded accounting basis

UTC calendar month containing the frozen handling time. Count completed request events of source subtype amendment for this holding; cancelled and rejected requests do not count.

title: Virtual Compute: category-specific metering rules
content:
## Retired clause 1

This former Virtual Compute handling clause is no longer in force: “snapshot bills GB-month at snapshot storage rate;” Its basis has been superseded.

## Retired clause 2

This former Virtual Compute handling clause is no longer in force: “For every ancillary meter, multiply the nonincluded measured quantity by its selected rate, then round the net line using monetary decimal precision and rounding convention and tax under the applicable tax treatment.” Its basis has been superseded.

## Formal basis

Virtual Compute — The primary instance package has virtual core count virtual cores, memory in GiB memory and included boot storage in GB included boot storage. Standard Linux primary usage uses the ordinary primary price. For dedicated configuration multiply the undiscounted primary rate by dedicated tenancy multiplier before the normal discount priority. For spot configuration use spot discount fraction instead of every commitment, promotion and portfolio discount; spot is mutually exclusive with a reservation and approved negotiated pricing. Meter code boot storage bills only provisioned GB-month above included boot storage in GB at boot disk rate. windows license bills actual vCPU-hours at windows license rate and linux license at linux license rate, independently of compute discounts. image export bills processed GB at image export rate. internet egress bills actual monthly GB beyond included monthly internet transfer in GB at egress rate. Resource count, measured duration and the selected tier virtual core count determine licensed vCPU-hours; changing capacity splits intervals. A zero-rate license or included transfer creates no charge. The separate Network contract never rebills transfer already marked as compute-managed on its source resource export. An allowance is consumed chronologically by service interval start then original source reference within the named holding and UTC period; reversal of its source returns only that source allocation. Source subtype supplemental identifies these amounts so the primary discount policy does not apply. Completed service records prove nonfinancial entitlements; unknown meter codes or units are outside policy coverage instead of guessed prices. These calculations never authorize an unapproved customer-only action. For included capacities denominated in GB-month, contact-month or package-month, prorate the capacity by actual active interval seconds divided by actual seconds in its UTC month before comparing measured quantity. Category-specific primary inclusions replace the generic included primary quantity where expressly named; they are not added twice. A mandatory minimum fee is a pricing minimum, not a second charge.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for category-specific metering rules?**

The primary instance package has virtual core count virtual cores, memory in GiB memory and included boot storage in GB included boot storage.

title: Virtual Compute: evt collection
content:

Apply an explicitly referenced invoice first; if the remittance omits allocation, use default remittance allocation order, sorting invoice issue time then original source reference within the same customer and billing entity. Split across exact source invoice lines, never across legal billing entities. Each allocation is a separate negative payment amount linked to its original charge; any residual is an unallocated overpayment linked to the remittance reference. A repeated remittance reference and allocation target returns the existing posting. No receipt is inferred from a customer promise, and rejected or pending payments make no posting.

title: Virtual Compute: the invoice correction basis
content:
## Retired clause 1

This former Virtual Compute handling clause is no longer in force: “Correct an erroneous charge to the approved review pretax net amount plus tax amount, following the applicable tax treatment.” Its basis has been superseded.

## Formal basis

Virtual Compute — For source subtype correction, the source charge has an approved review with decision incorrect. This gate is inapplicable to other source subtype values. Compare that corrected gross amount with the source original gross amount less cumulative correction credits plus cumulative debit adjustments; do not include service-credit concessions in this correction comparison. Credit the positive overcharge, debit the positive undercharge, and make no write when equal. A credit amount is negative and its net and tax components preserve the source proportions except an approved tax correction. An upward correction carries positive amount. Return the existing adjustment when the reviewed target has already been achieved. No cash refund is implicit in an invoice correction. Link original source reference to the original charge and related evidence reference to the approved review, never to a broad invoice containing several lines. Use the gross correction total from the exact-source correction and service-credit totals for the correction comparison; the pretax service-credit total never changes the approved corrected billing target.

## Evidence — approved correction

For credit, debit adjustment, For source subtype correction, the source charge has an approved review with decision incorrect. This gate is inapplicable to other source subtype values. Before this action, authoritative system records establish the condition using evidence event reference, original source reference, related evidence reference, status, decision. Those records correlate to the current action by evidence event reference, original source reference, related evidence reference.

## Recorded accounting basis

All posted credit and debit adjustment events through the frozen handling time for the exact original source reference. For the exact original charge original source reference, report the gross correction total as absolute correction credit amount less debit-adjustment amount, and the pretax service-credit total as absolute pretax pretax net amount of service-credit postings. Keep these two named components separate; tax is included only in the gross correction total, and unrelated source charges never enter either component.

title: Virtual Compute: the lifecycle fee basis
content:
## Formal basis

Virtual Compute — This fee branch applies only to setup, resumption, termination and return fee source subtype. Charge setup fee once for an activated holding, resumption fee per distinct completed restoration, termination fee for on-demand exit, and failed payment fee per completed bank return. An unexpired commitment exit instead bills the recorded remaining signed commitment liability in USD as its termination liability. Copy the exact source transition, customer authorization or bank notice reference; do not use a primary meter as fee evidence. A zero fee is waived without a financial event. The fee amount is the selected policy amount or recorded signed liability, rounded using monetary decimal precision and rounding convention, then taxed under the applicable tax treatment. The primary-usage branch of primary usage pricing and its posted meter gate apply only to source subtype primary; supplemental charges use the category meter policy. Already billed source occurrence and fee subtype make repetition read-only.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for the lifecycle fee basis?**

This fee branch applies only to setup, resumption, termination and return fee source subtype.

title: Virtual Compute: evt incident
content:
