Virtual Compute — Operations record the closed incident, affected holding, exact incident external reference, official incident closing time, cause, measured duration hours and availability percent from the official operational report. No customer statement substitutes for the report. Scheduled maintenance, customer changes and upstream-customer events remain visible with their cause code even though the outage service-credit basis excludes them. Incident registration itself never creates a credit or changes contract status.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for evt incident?**

Operations record the closed incident, affected holding, exact incident external reference, official incident closing time, cause, measured duration hours and availability percent from the official operational report.

title: Virtual Compute: evt invoice
content:
## Formal basis

Virtual Compute — No posted charge exists for the same source event, meter, source subtype, pricing component and billing period. Group service charges by invoice grouping basis. Billing periods follow billing cycle in billing timezone, beginning at the first instant of the first date and ending exclusively at the first instant of the next month. For measured usage, invoice only services whose interval has ended; lifecycle fees instead require their source occurrence to be completed; use the posted authoritative source records. Set invoice issue time to the frozen handling time. Carry forward a positive grouped subtotal below minimum invoice amount rather than issuing an invoice; zero-rated usage stays visible as a meter and receives no monetary charge. A source charge already posted for the same source event, meter, quantity component and invoice period is returned without another charge. The fixed source reference and source subtype distinguish primary, supplemental, setup, termination, resumption and return-fee components.

## Evidence — unbilled source component

For charge, No posted charge exists for the same source event, meter, source subtype, pricing component and billing period. Before this action, authoritative system records establish the condition using evidence event reference, original source reference, meter kind, source subtype, pricing component, period, event type, status. Those records correlate to the current action by original source reference.

title: Virtual Compute: evt meter
content:
## Formal basis

Virtual Compute — The authoritative export confirms the resource interval and the measured quantity. Meters originate in the provider resource export. Primary meter quantities use primary usage unit; a meter is positive and a meter reversal is the negative of the exact erroneous source quantity, capped by the source quantity not already reversed. Keep original interval, region, configuration and source reference. bill actual measured usage overage permits measured quantities above included primary quantity; no service entitlement is invented by a meter write. Round measured quantities to quantity decimal precision using rounding convention, apply minimum billable primary quantity and round positive billable primary quantities upward to a whole billable primary increment. Stopped or suspended service accrues no primary running usage, but real retained storage and other supplemental services remain billable through supplemental meter. A rejected or cancelled source is not a billable meter. Repeated exports with the same resource, meter, interval and correction reference are read-only confirmations.

## Evidence — export evidence

For meter, meter reversal, supplemental meter, The authoritative export confirms the resource interval and the measured quantity. Before this action, authoritative system records establish the condition using evidence event reference, external reference, service interval start, service interval end, quantity. Those records correlate to the current action by evidence event reference.

## Account meaning

Net primary physical consumption from positive meter and negative meter reversal postings; quantities remain grouped by source service period for billing.

title: Virtual Compute: primary usage pricing
content:
## Retired clause 1

This former Virtual Compute handling clause is no longer in force: “The negotiated rate replaces the primary standard unit rate before applying the region factor and receives no further discount.” Its basis has been superseded.

## Retired clause 2

This former Virtual Compute handling clause is no longer in force: “No discount applies to taxes, license fees, standalone supplemental services or previously issued credits.” Its basis has been superseded.

## Formal basis

Virtual Compute — This policy and its gate apply only to primary usage source subtype; category-specific primary pricing overrides expressly stated in category-specific metering rules take priority. For source subtype primary, the source meter is posted and identifies the billed resource interval. This gate is inapplicable to other source subtype values. Use the tier recorded for each source service interval. Read standard unit rate and regional rate multiplier for primary usage. Allocate included primary quantity across primary meter sources of the same holding and period in service interval start then original source reference order; prorate it by actual active UTC seconds divided by actual seconds in that UTC calendar month. Only the positive quantity beyond the remaining included allowance is charged. Allocate committed quantity in that same order, splitting covered and uncovered primary quantities into distinguishable invoice lines. The holding commitment must cover the entire source interval to receive commitment discount fraction; a boundary-crossing interval is split at the recorded commitment boundary. For every quantity component choose the first applicable item in primary price selection priority: an approved negotiated rate when permission for an approved negotiated rate, then the committed fraction, then a recorded eligible promotion from eligible campaign channels, then portfolio eligibility, then standard. Promotions and reservations are mutually exclusive. Round the final service subtotal using monetary decimal precision and rounding convention after quantity multiplication, then apply the applicable tax treatment. Record pricing component for each split quantity branch; it is part of the invoice-line identity. Do not apply a billing-period portfolio discount to a partial source interval before the full source period is closed.

## Evidence — posted meter

For charge, For source subtype primary, the source meter is posted and identifies the billed resource interval. This gate is inapplicable to other source subtype values. Before this action, authoritative system records establish the condition using evidence event reference, status, service interval start, service interval end. Those records correlate to the current action by evidence event reference.

## Pricing judgement

The first applicable primary-pricing priority is selected separately for each quantity component. A commitment must cover the entire component interval; intervals crossing its boundary are split.

## Local hypothetical judgement

Hypothetically, no approved negotiated rate applies, a recorded commitment covers the entire quantity interval, and an eligible promotion also exists for that same quantity. Commitment pricing takes priority; the promotion is not combined with it.

title: Virtual Compute: evt refund
content:
## Retired clause 1

This former Virtual Compute handling clause is no longer in force: “Available refund is the smaller of the negative net receivable magnitude and original payment principal less prior returns and refunds linked to that payment.” Its basis has been superseded.

## Retired clause 2

This former Virtual Compute handling clause is no longer in force: “The customer files an exact refund authorization; the agent refunds a confirmed overpayment only to the method and destination of its original payment.” Its basis has been superseded.

## Formal basis

Virtual Compute — The customer-authorized refund request and completed original payment refer to the same holding and source payment. A requested amount exceeding the applicable refund limit is refused, not silently reduced. Use refund methods, require at least refund minimum, and record a positive receivable delta for cash paid out. A smaller positive balance remains on account. Refunds require no active service contract and remain possible after closure. Repetition of the same request and source payment returns the existing refund. A third-party destination or unconfirmed payment is refused.

## Evidence — refund consent

For refund, The customer-authorized refund request and completed original payment refer to the same holding and source payment. Before this action, authoritative system records establish the condition using evidence event reference, customer request reference, original source reference, status, compute contract reference. Those records correlate to the current action by evidence event reference, customer request reference, original source reference, compute contract reference.

## Recorded accounting basis

All posted financial events through the frozen handling time. Sum signed amount for charge, debit adjustment, payment return and refund together with negative amount for payment and credit, grouped by holding. The receivable is determined by those signed postings.

## Account meaning

Signed customer debt: service charges, upward adjustments, returned payments and refunds increase it; payments and credits decrease it.

title: Virtual Compute: evt request
content:
## Formal basis

Virtual Compute — Only the customer may file or cancel an authorization, claim or disposal request. Preserve the exact external reference and the narrowest original source reference. Set request notice time and event occurrence time to the frozen clock and status pending on filing; cancellation is a new request event with status cancelled linked to the original request. An unsupported channel is refused. A repeated identical request reference returns the existing event. Filing a request never confirms a system approval or changes an accounting balance.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for evt request?**

Only the customer may file or cancel an authorization, claim or disposal request.

title: Virtual Compute: evt return
content:

Restore the returned principal as a positive amount, up to the original payment amount not already returned. Copy its method, customer, billing entity and currency. A partial return uses the distinct bank notice external reference. A duplicate bank notice produces no new write. Any failed payment fee is a separately identifiable return-fee charge under the lifecycle fee basis, never hidden in returned principal; a waived fee produces no fee posting.

For payment return, The completed bank return notice refers to the exact original posted payment. Before this action, authoritative system records establish the condition using evidence event reference, original source reference, status, external reference. Those records correlate to the current action by evidence event reference, original source reference.

title: Virtual Compute: evt review
content:
## Retired clause 1

This former Virtual Compute handling clause is no longer in force: “Record decision correct or incorrect for a billing review, and eligible or ineligible for an outage claim; status approved means the review is complete and authoritative, not that a credit necessarily follows.” Its basis has been superseded.

## Retired clause 2

This former Virtual Compute handling clause is no longer in force: “Record corrected pretax net amount and tax amount for incorrect billing, or approved credit amount for an eligible outage after applying the outage service-credit basis.” Its basis has been superseded.

## Formal basis

Virtual Compute — The source event and the evidence record identify the same holding and narrowest business object. A service accountant reviews one precise source event against its authoritative export, contract terms, bank notice, tax record or incident record. A rejected review cannot authorize money movement. The customer may provide a locator but cannot dictate an official decision. Repeating the same source and request review returns the existing decision; materially new evidence is a distinct review linked through related evidence reference. Review alone books no money.

## Evidence — reviewable source

For review, The source event and the evidence record identify the same holding and narrowest business object. Before this action, authoritative system records establish the condition using evidence event reference, original source reference, related evidence reference, compute contract reference. Those records correlate to the current action by evidence event reference, original source reference, related evidence reference, compute contract reference.

title: Virtual Compute: the outage service-credit basis
content:
## Formal basis

Virtual Compute — For a service credit financial posting, an approved review has decision eligible and positive approved credit amount for the exact source charge; this gate does not constrain filing or reviewing the request. For a service credit request being filed, the outage claim is filed no later than outage claim filing period after the official incident closes. For a newly filed claim, frozen handling time is its request notice time; the request is recorded immediately. Later review and credit use that recorded request notice time to evaluate the same boundary, so a timely request does not expire while awaiting review. Add outage claim filing period UTC calendar dates to official incident closing time, preserving its time of day; calendar dates are counted without substituting business days or elapsed-hour periods. Equality at the deadline qualifies; a later claim is rejected without a credit. The provider incident must be completed, with cause outside outage exclusions. Availability at or above SLA target percent gives no credit. Below the target choose the first descending SLA credit bands entry whose minimum is no greater than the recorded availability percent. Multiply the original source charge pretax net amount by that fraction; subtract the pretax service-credit total component of prior credits for that exact source, and cap total service credits at cumulative outage credit cap fraction of that original net amount. Floor the additional credit at zero and round with monetary decimal precision and rounding convention. Apply the original tax component proportionately. A review writes its nonnegative approved result; a financial credit writes the negative approved amount only after that approved review exists. This service-credit branch applies only to source subtype service credit; the invoice correction basis applies only to source subtype correction. Excluded incidents, ineligible reviews and zero remaining entitlement result in no financial write. A request for consequential-loss compensation is not covered. A service-credit financial posting requires an approved review with decision eligible and positive approved credit amount; the request and incident alone cannot authorize the financial posting.

## Evidence — claim deadline

For request, For a service credit request being filed, the outage claim is filed no later than outage claim filing period after the official incident closes. Before this action, authoritative system records establish the condition using evidence event reference, official incident closing time, request notice time. Those records correlate to the current action by evidence event reference.

## Calendar boundary

Add outage claim filing period UTC calendar dates to official incident closing time, preserving its time of day; calendar dates are counted without substituting business days or elapsed-hour periods. The anchor is official incident closing time, recording the official incident closes. The duration is outage claim filing period. Equality at the boundary qualifies.

## Hypothetical case

Hypothetically, a claim filed at the incident-based deadline meets the time condition; a claim filed later is rejected without a credit. Later review uses the recorded notice time, so a timely filing remains timely.

## Evidence — approved service credit

For credit, For a service credit financial posting, an approved review has decision eligible and positive approved credit amount for the exact source charge; this gate does not constrain filing or reviewing the request. Before this action, authoritative system records establish the condition using evidence event reference, original source reference, status, decision, approved credit amount. Those records correlate to the current action by original source reference.

title: Virtual Compute: the applicable tax treatment
content:
## Formal basis

Virtual Compute — The applicable tax classification has an approved system review. Use the source contract tax treatment reviewed at the service date and tax rate schedule. Apply tax to the final rounded net service amount; round tax separately using monetary decimal precision and rounding convention. For a correction or credit use the original charge tax basis unless an approved tax-error review supplies the corrected treatment. Tax credits have negative tax amount; charges and upward adjustments have positive tax amount. Unsupported tax jurisdictions are outside policy coverage, not assumed exempt. Sum net subtotal and signed tax to obtain the financial amount. A verified exemption overrides the ordinary taxable rate; there is no stacking of tax treatments.

## Evidence — tax evidence

For charge, credit, debit adjustment, The applicable tax classification has an approved system review. Before this action, authoritative system records establish the condition using compute contract reference, tax review status, tax treatment. Those records correlate to the current action by compute contract reference.

title: Virtual Compute: exit
content:
## Formal basis

Virtual Compute — The customer has filed the exact resource-disposal authorization for this contract. Only the customer may withdraw an application or terminate their provisioned resources. An applied contract can be withdrawn without any setup, usage or termination charge. For active or suspended contracts, record closure date from the frozen clock and stop running primary meters at the exact customer-confirmed close time. Accrued usage and actual retained-resource charges remain payable; closing never erases receivables or credits. termination fee applies to an on-demand exit under the lifecycle fee basis. If a signed commitment remains unexpired and permission to forgive an unexpired commitment on cancellation is false, invoice its recorded remaining signed commitment liability in USD as a distinct termination component, without also charging future usage against that same liability. No new usage begins after closure; existing financial corrections, collection and refunds remain possible. Repeating the same closed-resource confirmation has no further effect. Before closing, the signed termination schedule supplies remaining signed commitment liability in USD and is zero when no unbilled commitment liability remains. A positive recorded liability necessarily triggers the distinct termination charge using the disposal request as its original source reference; closure and that one invoice entry complete the event chain.

## Evidence — customer disposal

For withdraw, close, close suspended, The customer has filed the exact resource-disposal authorization for this contract. Before this action, authoritative system records establish the condition using compute contract reference, customer request reference, original source reference. Those records correlate to the current action by compute contract reference, customer request reference, original source reference.

## Contract transition

The customer themselves performs the applied to closed contract transition using the authoritative evidence required for that action.

The customer themselves performs the active to closed contract transition using the authoritative evidence required for that action.

The customer themselves performs the suspended to closed contract transition using the authoritative evidence required for that action.

title: Virtual Compute: resumption
content:
## Formal basis

Virtual Compute — The contract status is suspended. The contract payment restriction status is clear. Restore a suspended holding after its official payment restriction clears; no customer promise substitutes for recorded clearance. Set status active. Bill resumption fee under the lifecycle fee basis only when positive, and preserve retained-resource history. A contract already active needs no write; a closed contract requires a new signed application and cannot be resumed.

## Evidence — contract state

For resume, The contract status is suspended. Before this action, authoritative system records establish the condition using compute contract reference, status. Those records correlate to the current action by compute contract reference.

## Evidence — restriction cleared

For resume, The contract payment restriction status is clear. Before this action, authoritative system records establish the condition using compute contract reference, payment restriction status. Those records correlate to the current action by compute contract reference.

## Contract transition

The agent performs the suspended to active contract transition using the authoritative evidence required for that action.

title: Virtual Compute: suspension
content:
## Formal basis

Virtual Compute — The contract status is active. Collection suspension occurs no earlier than invoice maturity period plus collection suspension grace period after the source invoice is issued. The contract payment restriction status is restricted and the source invoice retains unpaid principal. Add invoice maturity period and then collection suspension grace period UTC calendar dates to invoice issue time, preserving its time of day; do not use business days or replace the anchor with contract activation. Equality qualifies. The source overdue invoice must retain a positive unpaid principal; a fully paid invoice cannot justify suspension. Earlier handling sends an informational explanation without a status change. An agent suspends active service only when official payment restriction status is restricted; ordinary billing disputes alone do not suspend service. Retained ancillary resources can still produce actual supplemental usage. Repeated handling of an already suspended contract makes no new transition.

## Evidence — contract state

For suspend, The contract status is active. Before this action, authoritative system records establish the condition using compute contract reference, status. Those records correlate to the current action by compute contract reference.

## Evidence — collection deadline

For suspend, Collection suspension occurs no earlier than invoice maturity period plus collection suspension grace period after the source invoice is issued. Before this action, authoritative system records establish the condition using evidence event reference, invoice issue time. Those records correlate to the current action by evidence event reference.

## Calendar boundary

Add invoice maturity period and then collection suspension grace period UTC calendar dates to invoice issue time, preserving its time of day; do not use business days or replace the anchor with contract activation. The anchor is invoice issue time, recording the source invoice is issued. The duration is total collection days. Equality at the boundary qualifies.

## Hypothetical case

Hypothetically, at the earliest suspension boundary the time condition is met; on the preceding UTC calendar date it is unmet, producing only an informational explanation without a status change.

## Evidence — collection restriction

For suspend, The contract payment restriction status is restricted and the source invoice retains unpaid principal. title: Virtual Compute: assisted cash resolution procedure
content:
## Situation

Virtual Compute — An existing customer-filed maximum-refund request concerns the latest paid primary source line. A corrected source target creates a surplus whose permitted payout is assessed by the accountant and disposed of by the customer personally; one payout completes the request, with any remaining surplus retained.

## Ordered action 1

1. The agent records the primary arithmetic review using review_compute_line_e30849b6. Every physical export and original source charge already exists; the desk completes this arithmetic review synchronously.

## Ordered action 2

2. The agent posts the primary correction credit using credit_compute_line_adb33dcc. The preceding review provides the approved incorrect target; this call immediately posts the correction.

## Ordered action 3

3. The agent records the numerical refund assessment using authorize_compute_refund_4fb241f0. The original filed request and posted payment preexist the consultation; the preceding credit is now posted. The accountant performs the request/payment reconciliation and records its numerical assessment synchronously.

## Ordered action 4

4. The customer themselves executes the permitted refund using refund_compute_payment_f0565a85. Original customer consent is recorded at opening; the preceding accountant tool has completed the eligibility assessment and returns its reference. The customer immediately executes the handed-over disposition tool; no later action depends on its receipt.

## Reference handovers

The review reference becomes the correction’s related evidence. The correction reference becomes the assessment’s posted-correction reference. The approved assessment reference becomes the customer refund’s related evidence.

## Ordering basis

The primary review precedes correction because its approved net target determines the credit. The credit precedes the refund assessment because the exact posted correction reference and its resulting surplus are inputs to that assessment. The assessment precedes customer disposition because its approved numerical ceiling and returned reference constrain the actual payout. Customer signature consent is already present on the original request; no asynchronous signature approval, payment clearing or other external event is manufactured.

## Synchronous execution

All original customer consent, export and posted payment records preexist the consultation. Review, credit and refund assessment are synchronous accountant actions. The customer then executes the final disposition using the already returned assessment reference; no subsequent call consumes the user-generated receipt.

## Hypothetical case

Hypothetically, correction before review lacks the approved target; assessment before correction lacks the posted credit reference and its resulting surplus; customer payout before assessment lacks the approved ceiling and returned assessment reference.

title: Managed Database: personal correction authorization applicability
content:
## Applicable business situation
Managed Database personal correction authorization is governed by these scope conditions. The linked resource count must be a positive integer within the database tier maximum resource count, and measured node-hours must fit the resource count and the actual source month. The approved negotiated rate for this route must be nonnegative and no greater than the standard tier unit rate; higher negotiated rates retain ordinary source-based correction handling. This signed credit workflow applies only when the reconstructed corrected gross target is strictly less than the original gross charge plus cumulative signed correction credits and debit adjustments for that exact source. Determine this comparison from the source evidence before selecting the workflow. Undercharges use the inherited positive-debit correction rule and equal corrected balances use its no-write rule; neither is handled by this credit workflow. This consolidated primary-export route applies where archive quantities are whole hundredths of a node-hour; finer export quantities retain the ordinary source-meter route. This branch handles a requested correction of one closed-period primary invoice for an on-demand, nonpromotional database contract below the portfolio threshold, with reviewed verified exempt tax treatment and a single active Managed Backup holding for the same customer and billing entity. The signed linked topology and the original source invoice both record the same resource count; all selected export records use that source and count. The historical source tier and configuration must match the current database contract. No other invoice line is included and no refund is implicit.

title: Managed Database: handling personal correction authorization
content:
## Business purpose
Managed Database personal correction authorization supports the requested account correction. The customer alone files the correction authorization after receiving the reviewed figure; use the customer-supplied external reference unchanged. Use the existing unsigned general request selected by the database holding authorization request reference, with original source reference matching the original invoice and the same exact external reference the customer supplies. This request is only an enquiry while source type is request and quantity is zero; it is not correction consent. Personal filing updates that same record in place to source type correction and the authorized amount, preserves its database occurrence reference and exact external reference, and links it to the approved current review. Do not create a second request record. Copy the preserved request identifier from the initial account query and confirm its signed status and amount in the actual customer filing receipt before posting the credit. Set source type correction, meter classification none, quantity unit USD, quantity equal to the authorized amount, status pending and filing time to the current handling clock. This correction authorization is not a service credit outage claim and therefore the conditional outage-claim deadline does not apply.

## Capability
Personally file a database invoice correction authorization for the stated amount. Update the existing unsigned request in place, linking it to the original charge and billing review and recording the customer's exact existing reference, authorized amount and current filing time. The request authorizes the customer's own account correction and does not itself change the balance.

## Invocation
The tool post_correction_consent_d1041c04 must first be unlocked and handed over, to be run by the customer themselves.

## Parameters
- database_event_id: Reference — Identifier of the original database invoice charge record obtained from find_database_events.
- database_holding_id: Reference — Identifier of the database contract obtained from find_database_holdings.
- customer_id: Reference — Identifier of the verified enterprise customer profile obtained from find_customers.
- related_event_id: Reference — Identifier of the approved billing review record obtained from its receipt or find_database_events.
- request_id: Reference — Identifier of the existing unsigned request selected by the contract request_id, obtained from find_database_holdings and find_database_events.
- external_reference: Exact text — Copy the correction authorization reference supplied by the customer character for character, preserving wording, digits and punctuation with no translation, normalization, summarization, addition or deletion (verbatim).
- quantity: Decimal — Personally authorized correction amount; unit USD. Decimal quantity to six decimal places; monetary USD value limited to two decimal places, round half-up once at submission, no empty value.

## Successful return
String receipt with request_id (the existing request reference now personally signed), quantity (authorized USD amount to two decimals) and pending status, confirming immediate filing by the customer.

title: Managed Database: handling external retention allocation
content:
## Business purpose
Managed Database external retention allocation supports the requested account correction. This reconciliation applies when the customer requests correction of the retained-storage entitlement record for a closed service period, identified by an existing authorization request. It changes only nonfinancial service entitlements; historical invoices are not adjusted and no money movement is implied. Complete the existing pending assessment named by its external reference, with exactly one update per assessment. The assessment external reference is External retention allocation.

## Capability
Record the externally protected portion of retained database storage. Replace the database retention assessment's quantity and set its status to completed. A completed receipt confirms that the corrected entitlement is recorded and available to account readers.

## Invocation
record_external_retention_8927a6d4 is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call) by the agent.

## Parameters

title: Managed Database: external retention allocation — assessment outcome
content:
## Assessment basis
Managed Database external retention allocation uses the following assessment outcome basis. Multiply the external protected capacity by the nonnegative excess of allocation horizon over native included days, divide by that horizon, and round half-up to six decimal GB-month places once at the final outcome. If the horizon equals native included days the external allocation is zero.

## Hypothetical calculation
Hypothetical inputs: protected capacity is 120 GB-month, the allocation horizon is 30 days and native inclusion is 10 days. The excess is 20 days. Multiplying 120 by 20 and dividing by 30 gives 80.000000 GB-month. If both durations are 10 days, the excess and allocation are zero.

Managed Database native retention allocation uses the following protected capacity limit basis. External protected capacity is the smaller of measured retained quantity and active Managed Backup included capacity; it does not create a second native allowance.

## Capacity case
Hypothetical inputs: measured retention of 80 GB-month and protection capacity of 50 GB-month produce a protected capacity limit of 50 GB-month. Increasing only the hypothetical protection capacity to 90 GB-month makes the limit 80 GB-month.

title: Managed Database: native retention allocation — residual entitlement
content:
## Assessment basis
Managed Database native retention allocation uses the following residual entitlement basis. Subtract the completed external allocation from measured retained quantity and floor that remainder at zero.

## Remainder case
Hypothetical inputs: measured retained quantity is 12 GB-month and completed external allocation is 15 GB-month. Subtraction gives a negative remainder, so the retained remainder is zero.

title: Managed Database: native retention allocation — assessment outcome
content:
## Assessment basis
Managed Database native retention allocation uses the following assessment outcome basis. Take the smallest of the remaining quantity, native capacity and external protected capacity; multiply that subtotal by native included days divided by the allocation horizon, then round half-up once to six decimal GB-month places.

## Hypothetical calculation
Hypothetical inputs: remaining retained quantity is 90 GB-month, native capacity is 80 GB-month, protected capacity is 60 GB-month, native inclusion is 10 days and the allocation horizon is 30 days. The smallest capacity is 60; its duration proportion produces 20.000000 GB-month. Scaling only the remaining quantity before choosing the smallest capacity would incorrectly give 30.000000 GB-month.

title: Managed Database: native retained-storage allocation — export retained-storage horizon
content:
## Assessment basis
Managed Database native retained-storage allocation uses the following export retained-storage horizon basis. Use the maximum retained-storage days from those same completed supplemental backup storage service records as the retained-storage horizon.

title: Managed Database: native retention allocation — original invoice identification
content:
## Assessment basis
Managed Database native retention allocation uses the following original invoice identification basis. Use the original invoice originating record identified by the holding authorization request; all retention exports and assessments are correlated to that exact originating record.

title: Managed Database: contract activation
content:
## Governing clause
Managed Database contract activation applies to database activate. The contract status is applied. The contract contract approval is approved. Activate an approved application after provisioning evidence confirms the configured resources; record activation time from the current handling clock. Refuse rejected or pending applications. Setup is invoiced under lifecycle and bank fees when setup fee is positive; a waived setup fee creates no charge. Repeating an activation of an already active contract is a read-only confirmation, not another activation.

## Evidence: contract state
The contract status is applied. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database contract reference, status. The correlated evidence must refer together to database contract reference. 

## Evidence: provisioning approval
The contract contract approval is approved. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database contract reference, contract approval. The correlated evidence must refer together to database contract reference.

title: Managed Database: signed application admission
content:
## Governing clause
Managed Database signed application admission applies to database open. The signed application request has an approved service review. The customer signs and submits the application through an authorized channels channel. Create status applied and application registration date from the current handling clock, with no consumption or charge. The requested tier supplies maximum resource count; reject unsupported regions, unsupported currency, resource counts above that limit, and unapproved contract terms without a write. The customer owns the signature; an agent cannot sign for them. Entry gates are evaluated against the authoritative signed application fields copied into the proposed holding.

## Evidence: signed approval
The signed application request has an approved service review. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database occurrence reference, authorization request reference, status, decision. The correlated evidence must refer together to database occurrence reference, authorization request reference.

title: Managed Database: independent resource scopes
content:
## Governing clause
Managed Database independent resource scopes applies to database open. The signed resource scope is not already represented by a nonclosed contract. Multiple independent resource scopes may be held. Use external reference as the signed resource-scope key. Count all nonclosed holdings of this category for the same customer; refuse creation if the count would exceed maximum contracts per customer. A repeated signed application with the same external resource scope reuses the existing contract rather than opening another.

## Evidence: scope unique
The signed resource scope is not already represented by a nonclosed contract. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database contract reference, customer reference, status, external reference. The correlated evidence must refer together to database contract reference, customer reference. 

## Specific basis: maximum contracts per customer
Maximum contracts per customer: 24.

title: Managed Database: portfolio usage eligibility
content:
## Governing clause
Managed Database portfolio usage eligibility applies to database charge. Use posted portfolio usage subtotal to select the portfolio discount. Combine only holdings of this category owned by the same customer with the same legal billing entity and source period, even if some have since closed. No cross-entity or cross-category spending counts. The threshold comparison is inclusive. Portfolio discount applies only to primary service usage and only if no higher-priority price applies; it is neither a cash credit nor a deduction from ancillary service fees.

## Account measurement
The source period, a UTC calendar month; customer and legal billing entity match the proposed charge. Sum posted primary meter quantities net of meter reversal by holding, multiply each interval by its applicable standard tier unit rate and region factor without any discount or tax, and sum across this category. Exclude ancillary meters and never sum already discounted invoices.

title: Managed Database: capacity amendments
content:
## Governing clause
Managed Database capacity amendments applies to database amend. The contract status is active or suspended. The source amendment request is approved and customer-authorized. The customer files a signed amendment request before the agent applies the approved attributes. The request external reference identifies the signed amendment; its related approved review carries the affected exact values and effective service interval start. Request and review events preserve those effective attributes. Keep status unchanged, use the new tier only for service intervals beginning at the request effective time, and retain old tier and effective price on earlier meter and invoice records. Refuse any change above maximum resource count or when completed monthly amendments has reached amendment limit. Completed amendment requests count once; pending, rejected or cancelled requests do not change the holding. Signed commitments keep their recorded expiration and remaining contractual liability unless the signed amendment explicitly replaces them.

## Evidence: contract state
The contract status is active or suspended. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database contract reference, status. The correlated evidence must refer together to database contract reference. 

## Evidence: amendment approved
The source amendment request is approved and customer-authorized. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database occurrence reference, status, authorization request reference, source type. The correlated evidence must refer together to database occurrence reference, authorization request reference. 

## Account measurement
UTC calendar month containing the current handling time. Count completed request events of source type amendment for this holding; cancelled and rejected requests do not count.

title: Managed Database: database service meters
content:
## Governing clause
Managed Database database service meters applies to database charge, database supplemental meter, database service record. Each primary node has vCore count cores, memory in GiB memory and included storage GB per node. Primary standard node-hours use standard unit rate. Configuration high availability multiplies primary node rate by high availability multiplier; configuration replica uses read replica multiplier, mutually exclusively. commercial engine license separately bills actual vCore-hours at commercial license rate; the configuration or engine entitlement does not waive that license. storage bills provisioned GB-month beyond included storage GB per node at storage rate. iops bills provisioned IOPS-month beyond included IOPS at IOPS rate. backup storage bills GB-month retained beyond included native retention days at backup storage rate, with the export separating retention segments; restoration itself is not counted as storage. restore bills restored GB at restore rate. Included native retention is not multiplied by the number of restores. Nodes stopped for a suspended contract produce no running node-hours but still accrue retained storage. The following former clause is no longer in force: “Managed Backup is a separately held protection service and never automatically overrides native database retention or license pricing.” For every ancillary meter, multiply the nonincluded measured quantity by its selected rate, then round the net line using monetary decimal precision and rounding convention and tax under tax calculation. An allowance is consumed chronologically by service interval start then original source reference within the named holding and UTC period; reversal of its source returns only that source allocation. Source subtype supplemental identifies these amounts so the primary discount policy does not apply. Completed service records prove nonfinancial entitlements; unknown meter codes or units are outside policy coverage instead of guessed prices. These calculations never authorize an unapproved customer-only action. For included capacities denominated in GB-month, contact-month or package-month, prorate the capacity by actual active interval seconds divided by actual seconds in its UTC month before comparing measured quantity. Category-specific primary inclusions replace the generic included quantity where expressly named; they are not added twice. A mandatory minimum fee is a pricing minimum, not a second charge.

## Ancillary amount treatment
For an ancillary charge, determine the nonincluded measured quantity, multiply it by the selected ancillary rate, round that net line using the monetary precision and rounding convention, and apply tax. Chronological allowance allocation stays within the named contract and UTC period. A reversal restores only its originating allocation.

## Restore-count case
Hypothetical condition case: a database has one restore instead of several restores. Changing only the number of restores does not multiply its included native retention, because the clause expressly excludes restore-count multiplication.

title: Managed Database: remittance allocation
content:
## Governing clause
Managed Database remittance allocation applies to database payment. The bank record confirms the remittance as completed. Record only a bank-confirmed remittance using a payment methods rail and the amount actually received in currency. Customer consent to dispose of funds belongs to the customer; the agent only allocates a payment already confirmed by the bank. Apply an explicitly referenced invoice first; if the remittance omits allocation, use collection order, sorting invoice issue time then original source reference within the same customer and billing entity. Split across exact source invoice lines, never across legal billing entities. Each allocation is a separate negative payment amount linked to its original charge; any residual is an unallocated overpayment linked to the remittance reference. A repeated remittance reference and allocation target returns the existing posting. No receipt is inferred from a customer promise, and rejected or pending payments make no posting.

## Evidence: confirmed payment
The bank record confirms the remittance as completed. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database occurrence reference, status, external reference, method. The correlated evidence must refer together to database occurrence reference. 

## Account measurement
All posted financial events through the current handling time. Sum signed amount for charge, debit adjustment, payment return and refund together with negative amount for payment and credit, grouped by holding. No independently writable balance is stored.

title: Managed Database: assisted amendment channels
content:
## Governing clause
Managed Database assisted amendment channels applies to database charge. A current Northbridge Enterprise Support holding for the same customer and billing entity provides assisted invoice explanation, but does not itself reduce this category price or waive debt. An approved negotiated rate is a contract-specific override; the presence of a paid support holding makes assisted negotiated-amendment intake available through support as well as portal and API. Without that combination the signed amendment is submitted through portal or API. A promotional primary-price entitlement is suppressed wherever a commitment price covers the same quantity, and no benefit from an unrelated category is stacked. The combination changes only request-channel eligibility, not approval authority.

title: Managed Database: source charge correction
content:
## Governing clause
Managed Database source charge correction applies to database credit, database debit adjustment. For source type correction, the source charge has an approved review with decision incorrect. This gate is inapplicable to other source type values. Correct an erroneous charge to the approved review net amount plus tax amount, following tax calculation. Compare that corrected gross amount with the source original gross amount less cumulative correction credits plus cumulative debit adjustments; do not include service-credit concessions in this correction comparison. Credit the positive overcharge, debit the positive undercharge, and make no write when equal. A credit amount is negative and its net and tax components preserve the source proportions except an approved tax correction. An upward correction carries positive amount. Return the existing adjustment when the reviewed target has already been achieved. No cash refund is implicit in an invoice correction. Link original source reference to the original charge and linked evidence reference to the approved review, never to a broad invoice containing several lines. Use gross correction amount from source correction and concession amounts for the correction comparison; net service concession amount never changes the approved corrected billing target.

## Evidence: approved correction
For source type correction, the source charge has an approved review with decision incorrect. This gate is inapplicable to other source type values. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database occurrence reference, original source reference, linked evidence reference, status, decision. The correlated evidence must refer together to database occurrence reference, original source reference, linked evidence reference. 

## Hypothetical correction comparison
Hypothetical inputs: the original gross charge is USD 100, prior correction credits total USD 20, prior debit adjustments total USD 5 and the approved corrected gross amount is USD 70. The correction-adjusted gross amount is USD 85, leaving a USD 15 overcharge. The signed credit is negative USD 15. An independent service concession of USD 8 would not change this comparison.

## Account measurement
All posted credit and debit adjustment events through the current handling time for the exact original source reference. For the exact original charge original source reference, report gross correction amount as absolute correction credit amount less debit-adjustment amount, and net service concession amount as absolute pretax net amount of service-credit postings. Keep these two named components separate; tax is included only in gross correction amount, and unrelated source charges never enter either component.

title: Managed Database: lifecycle and bank fees
content:
## Governing clause
Managed Database lifecycle and bank fees applies to database charge. This fee branch applies only to setup, resumption, termination and bank return fee source type. Charge setup fee once for an activated holding, resumption fee per distinct completed restoration, termination fee for on-demand exit, and failed payment fee per completed bank return. An unexpired commitment exit instead bills the recorded remaining signed commitment liability in USD as its termination liability. Copy the exact source transition, customer authorization or bank notice reference; do not use a primary meter as fee evidence. A zero fee is waived without a financial event. The fee amount is the selected policy amount or recorded signed liability, rounded using monetary decimal precision and rounding convention, then taxed under tax calculation. The primary-usage branch of primary usage pricing and its posted meter gate apply only to source type primary; supplemental charges use the category meter policy. Already billed source occurrence and fee subtype make repetition read-only.

title: Managed Database: official incident recording
content:
## Governing clause
Managed Database official incident recording applies to database incident. Operations record the closed incident, affected holding, exact incident external reference, official incident close time, cause, measured duration hours and availability percent from the official operational report. No customer statement substitutes for the report. Scheduled maintenance, customer changes and upstream-customer events remain visible with their cause code even though outage service credits excludes them. Incident registration itself never creates a credit or changes contract status.

title: Managed Database: invoice issuance
content:
## Governing clause
Managed Database invoice issuance applies to database charge. No posted charge exists for the same source event, meter, source subtype, pricing component and billing period. Group service charges by invoice grouping. Billing periods follow billing cycle in billing timezone, beginning at the first instant of the first date and ending exclusively at the first instant of the next month. For measured usage, invoice only services whose interval has ended; lifecycle fees instead require their source occurrence to be completed; use the posted authoritative source records. Set invoice issue time to the current handling time. Carry forward a positive grouped subtotal below minimum invoice amount rather than issuing an invoice; zero-rated usage stays visible as a meter and receives no monetary charge. A source charge already posted for the same source event, meter, quantity component and invoice period is returned without another charge. The fixed source reference and source type distinguish primary, supplemental, setup, termination, resumption and return-fee components.

## Evidence: unbilled source component
No posted charge exists for the same source event, meter, source subtype, pricing component and billing period. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database occurrence reference, original source reference, meter classification, source type, effective price component, period, event type, status. The correlated evidence must refer together to original source reference.

title: Managed Database: authoritative metering
content:
## Governing clause
Managed Database authoritative metering applies to database meter, database meter reversal, database supplemental meter. The authoritative export confirms the resource interval and the measured quantity. Meters originate in the provider resource export. Primary meter quantities use primary usage unit; a meter is positive and a meter reversal is the negative of the exact erroneous source quantity, capped by the source quantity not already reversed. Keep original interval, region, configuration and source reference. bill actual usage overage permits measured quantities above included quantity; no service entitlement is invented by a meter write. Round measured quantities to quantity decimal precision using rounding convention, apply minimum primary quantity and round positive billable primary quantities upward to a whole meter increment. Stopped or suspended service accrues no primary running usage, but real retained storage and other supplemental services remain billable through supplemental meter. A rejected or cancelled source is not a billable meter. Repeated exports with the same resource, meter, interval and correction reference are read-only confirmations.

## Evidence: export evidence
The authoritative export confirms the resource interval and the measured quantity. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database occurrence reference, external reference, service interval start, service interval end, quantity. The correlated evidence must refer together to database occurrence reference.

title: Managed Database: primary usage pricing
content:
## Governing clause
Managed Database primary usage pricing applies to database charge. This policy and its gate apply only to primary usage source type; category-specific primary pricing overrides expressly stated in database service meters take priority. For source type primary, the source meter is posted and identifies the billed resource interval. This gate is inapplicable to other source type values. Use the tier recorded for each source service interval. Read standard unit rate and regional usage multipliers for primary usage. Allocate included quantity across primary meter sources of the same holding and period in service interval start then original source reference order; prorate it by actual active UTC seconds divided by actual seconds in that UTC calendar month. Only the positive quantity beyond the remaining included allowance is charged. Allocate committed quantity in that same order, splitting covered and uncovered primary quantities into distinguishable invoice lines. The holding commitment must cover the entire source interval to receive reservation discounts; a boundary-crossing interval is split at the recorded commitment boundary. For every quantity component choose the first applicable item in discount priority: an approved negotiated rate when negotiated rate allowed, then the committed fraction, then a recorded eligible promotion from promotion channels, then portfolio eligibility, then standard. The negotiated rate replaces the primary standard unit rate before applying the region factor and receives no further discount. Promotions and reservations are mutually exclusive. Round the final service subtotal using monetary decimal precision and rounding convention after quantity multiplication, then apply tax calculation. No discount applies to taxes, license fees, standalone supplemental services or previously issued credits. Record effective price component for each split quantity branch; it is part of the invoice-line identity. Do not apply a billing-period portfolio discount to a partial source interval before the full source period is closed.

## Evidence: posted meter
For source type primary, the source meter is posted and identifies the billed resource interval. This gate is inapplicable to other source type values. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database occurrence reference, status, service interval start, service interval end. The correlated evidence must refer together to database occurrence reference. 

## Quantity and price treatment
| Stage | Treatment of the primary source quantity |
|---|---|
| Included allowance | Allocate in service-start and original-reference order; charge only positive excess |
| Commitment | Allocate in the same order and distinguish covered from uncovered invoice lines |
| Effective price | Select the first applicable priority entry for each quantity component |
| Negotiated unit rate | Replace the standard rate before the regional multiplier; apply no further discount |
| Service rounding | Round after quantity multiplication, before tax |

## Price-priority case
Hypothetical condition case: a quantity component has an approved permitted negotiated rate and also a recorded eligible promotion. The negotiated rate replaces the standard unit rate before the regional multiplier and receives no promotional discount. Applying both would contradict the explicit no-further-discount rule.

title: Managed Database: original payment refunds
content:
## Governing clause
Managed Database original payment refunds applies to database refund. The customer-authorized refund request and completed original payment refer to the same holding and source payment. The customer files an exact refund authorization; the agent refunds a confirmed overpayment only to the method and destination of its original payment. Available refund is the smaller of the negative net receivable magnitude and original payment principal less prior returns and refunds linked to that payment. A requested amount exceeding that limit is refused, not silently reduced. Use refund methods, require at least refund minimum, and record a positive receivable delta for cash paid out. A smaller positive balance remains on account. Refunds require no active service contract and remain possible after closure. Repetition of the same request and source payment returns the existing refund. A third-party destination or unconfirmed payment is refused.

## Evidence: refund consent
The customer-authorized refund request and completed original payment refer to the same holding and source payment. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database occurrence reference, authorization request reference, original source reference, status, database contract reference. The correlated evidence must refer together to database occurrence reference, authorization request reference, original source reference, database contract reference. 

## Hypothetical refund limit
Hypothetical inputs: net receivable is negative USD 90, the original completed payment is USD 100, its prior returns total USD 30 and its prior refunds total USD 20. The balance magnitude is USD 90 and unused original principal is USD 50. The refund limit is USD 50. A request for USD 60 exceeds this limit and is refused rather than reduced.

title: Managed Database: customer request filing
content:
## Governing clause
Managed Database customer request filing applies to database request. Only the customer may file or cancel an authorization, claim or disposal request. Preserve the exact external reference and the narrowest original source reference. Set filing time and occurrence time to the current handling clock and status pending on filing; cancellation is a new request event with status cancelled linked to the original request. An unsupported channel is refused. A repeated identical request reference returns the existing event. Filing a request never confirms a system approval or changes an accounting balance.

title: Managed Database: returned remittances
content:
## Governing clause
Managed Database returned remittances applies to database payment return. The completed bank return notice refers to the exact original posted payment. The bank return must identify the exact posted payment. Restore the returned principal as a positive amount, up to the original payment amount not already returned. Copy its method, customer, billing entity and currency. A partial return uses the distinct bank notice external reference. A duplicate bank notice produces no new write. Any failed payment fee is a separately identifiable return-fee charge under lifecycle and bank fees, never hidden in returned principal; a waived fee produces no fee posting.

## Evidence: bank return
The completed bank return notice refers to the exact original posted payment. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database occurrence reference, original source reference, status, external reference. The correlated evidence must refer together to database occurrence reference, original source reference.

title: Managed Database: accountant source review
content:
## Governing clause
Managed Database accountant source review applies to database review. The source event and the evidence record identify the same holding and narrowest business object. A service accountant reviews one precise source event against its authoritative export, contract terms, bank notice, tax record or incident record. Record decision correct or incorrect for a billing review, and eligible or ineligible for an outage claim; status approved means the review is complete and authoritative, not that a credit necessarily follows. Record corrected net amount and tax amount for incorrect billing, or approved credit amount for an eligible outage after applying outage service credits. A rejected review cannot authorize money movement. The customer may provide a locator but cannot dictate an official decision. Repeating the same source and request review returns the existing decision; materially new evidence is a distinct review linked through linked evidence reference. Review alone books no money.

## Evidence: reviewable source
The source event and the evidence record identify the same holding and narrowest business object. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database occurrence reference, original source reference, linked evidence reference, database contract reference. The correlated evidence must refer together to database occurrence reference, original source reference, linked evidence reference, database contract reference.

title: Managed Database: outage service credits
content:
## Governing clause
Managed Database outage service credits applies to database request, database review, database credit. For a service credit financial posting, an approved review has decision eligible and positive approved credit amount for the exact source charge; this gate does not constrain filing or reviewing the request. For a service credit request being filed, the outage claim is filed no later than credit claim days after the official incident closes. For a newly filed claim, current handling time is its filing time; the request is recorded immediately. Later review and credit use that recorded filing time to evaluate the same boundary, so a timely request does not expire while awaiting review. Add credit claim days UTC calendar dates to official incident close time, preserving its time of day; calendar dates are counted without substituting business days or elapsed-hour periods. Equality at the deadline qualifies; a later claim is rejected without a credit. The provider incident must be completed, with cause outside outage exclusions. Availability at or above sla target percent gives no credit. Below the target choose the first descending sla credit bands entry whose minimum is no greater than the recorded availability percent. Multiply the original source charge net amount by that fraction; subtract the net service concession amount component of prior credits for that exact source, and cap total service credits at credit cap fraction of that original net amount. Floor the additional credit at zero and round with monetary decimal precision and rounding convention. Apply the original tax component proportionately. A review writes its nonnegative approved result; a financial credit writes the negative approved amount only after that approved review exists. This service-credit branch applies only to source type service credit; source charge correction applies only to source type correction. Excluded incidents, ineligible reviews and zero remaining entitlement result in no financial write. A request for consequential-loss compensation is not covered. A service-credit financial posting requires an approved review with decision eligible and positive approved credit amount; the request and incident alone cannot authorize the financial posting.

## Evidence: claim deadline
For a service credit request being filed, the outage claim is filed no later than credit claim days after the official incident closes. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database occurrence reference, official incident close time, filing time. The correlated evidence must refer together to database occurrence reference. Add credit claim days UTC calendar dates to official incident close time, preserving its time of day; calendar dates are counted without substituting business days or elapsed-hour periods. The comparison uses the current handling clock and includes equality at the boundary.

## Deadline boundary case
Hypothetical boundary case: filing exactly at the source-derived deadline satisfies this time gate; filing immediately after it does not. Later review uses the recorded timely filing time.

## Evidence: approved service credit
For a service credit financial posting, an approved review has decision eligible and positive approved credit amount for the exact source charge; this gate does not constrain filing or reviewing the request. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database occurrence reference, original source reference, status, decision, approved credit amount. The correlated evidence must refer together to original source reference. 

## Credit calculation sequence
1. Compare the recorded availability to the SLA target and select the applicable descending lower-inclusive band below that target.
2. Apply the selected fraction to the original net service amount.
3. Deduct prior net service concessions for that exact charge and respect the cumulative ceiling on the original net amount.
4. Floor the additional entitlement at zero and round it; preserve original tax proportionately.
5. An approved eligible positive review authorizes the negative financial credit.

## Availability equality case
Hypothetical boundary case: recorded availability is exactly the contractual SLA target. This produces no outage credit. A claim filed exactly at its incident-derived deadline can therefore be timely while having no availability entitlement.

title: Managed Database: tax calculation
content:
## Governing clause
Managed Database tax calculation applies to database charge, database credit, database debit adjustment. The applicable tax classification has an approved system review. Use the source contract tax treatment reviewed at the service date and tax rates. Apply tax to the final rounded net service amount; round tax separately using monetary decimal precision and rounding convention. For a correction or credit use the original charge tax basis unless an approved tax-error review supplies the corrected treatment. Tax credits have negative tax amount; charges and upward adjustments have positive tax amount. Unsupported tax jurisdictions are outside policy coverage, not assumed exempt. Sum net subtotal and signed tax to obtain the financial amount. A verified exemption overrides the ordinary taxable rate; there is no stacking of tax treatments.

## Evidence: tax evidence
The applicable tax classification has an approved system review. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database contract reference, tax review status, tax treatment. The correlated evidence must refer together to database contract reference.

title: Managed Database: customer disposal and closure
content:
## Governing clause
Managed Database customer disposal and closure applies to database withdraw, database close, database close suspended. The customer has filed the exact resource-disposal authorization for this contract. Only the customer may withdraw an application or terminate their provisioned resources. An applied contract can be withdrawn without any setup, usage or termination charge. For active or suspended contracts, record closure date from the current handling clock and stop running primary meters at the exact customer-confirmed close time. Accrued usage and actual retained-resource charges remain payable; closing never erases receivables or credits. termination fee applies to an on-demand exit under lifecycle and bank fees. If a signed commitment remains unexpired and commitment cancel allowed is false, invoice its recorded remaining signed commitment liability in USD as a distinct termination component, without also charging future usage against that same liability. No new usage begins after closure; existing financial corrections, collection and refunds remain possible. Repeating the same closed-resource confirmation has no further effect. Before closing, the signed termination schedule supplies remaining signed commitment liability in USD and is zero when no unbilled commitment liability remains. A positive recorded liability necessarily triggers the distinct termination charge using the disposal request as its original source reference; closure and that one invoice entry complete the event chain.

## Evidence: customer disposal
The customer has filed the exact resource-disposal authorization for this contract. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database contract reference, authorization request reference, original source reference. The correlated evidence must refer together to database contract reference, authorization request reference, original source reference.

title: Managed Database: service resumption
content:
## Governing clause
Managed Database service resumption applies to database resume. The contract status is suspended. The contract payment restriction is clear. Restore a suspended holding after its official payment restriction clears; no customer promise substitutes for recorded clearance. Set status active. Bill resumption fee under lifecycle and bank fees only when positive, and preserve retained-resource history. A contract already active needs no write; a closed contract requires a new signed application and cannot be resumed.

## Evidence: contract state
The contract status is suspended. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database contract reference, status. The correlated evidence must refer together to database contract reference. 

## Evidence: restriction cleared
The contract payment restriction is clear. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database contract reference, payment restriction. The correlated evidence must refer together to database contract reference.

title: Managed Database: collection suspension
content:
## Governing clause
Managed Database collection suspension applies to database suspend. The contract status is active. Collection suspension occurs no earlier than invoice due days plus suspension grace days after the source invoice is issued. The contract payment restriction is restricted and the source invoice retains unpaid principal. Add invoice due days and then suspension grace days UTC calendar dates to invoice issue time, preserving its time of day; do not use business days or replace the anchor with contract activation. Equality qualifies. The source overdue invoice must retain a positive unpaid principal; a fully paid invoice cannot justify suspension. Earlier handling sends an informational explanation without a status change. An agent suspends active service only when official payment restriction is restricted; ordinary billing disputes alone do not suspend service. Retained ancillary resources can still produce actual supplemental usage. Repeated handling of an already suspended contract makes no new transition.

## Evidence: contract state
The contract status is active. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database contract reference, status. The correlated evidence must refer together to database contract reference. 

## Evidence: collection deadline
Collection suspension occurs no earlier than invoice due days plus suspension grace days after the source invoice is issued. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database occurrence reference, invoice issue time. The correlated evidence must refer together to database occurrence reference. Add invoice due days and then suspension grace days UTC calendar dates to invoice issue time, preserving its time of day; do not use business days or replace the anchor with contract activation. The comparison uses the current handling clock and includes equality at the boundary.

## Deadline boundary case
Hypothetical boundary case: handling exactly at the source-derived deadline satisfies this time gate; handling immediately before it does not.

## Evidence: collection restriction
The contract payment restriction is restricted and the source invoice retains unpaid principal. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database contract reference, payment restriction, database occurrence reference, amount. The correlated evidence must refer together to database contract reference, database occurrence reference. 

## Specific basis: total collection days
Total collection days: The sum of the tier invoice due days and the tier suspension grace days..

title: Managed Database: primary per-node reconciliation applicability
content:

content:
## Procedure situation
Managed Database: A customer requests correction of a closed-period verified-exempt primary database invoice whose reconstructed target is strictly less than its correction-adjusted original charge, with linked backup topology evidence. Completion leaves the corrected target, personal authorization and exact remaining overcharge credit recorded. Undercharges and equal balances retain their ordinary inherited correction handling outside this workflow.

## Ordered responsibilities
1. The agent performs primary quantity reconciliation using post_primary_average_31a3f059.
2. The agent completes the accountant review using post_primary_target_faf69343.
3. The customer themselves performs personal authorization using post_correction_consent_d1041c04.
4. The agent posts the invoice correction credit using post_primary_correction_900303b8.

## Reference continuity
The quantity assessment reference identifies the evidence consumed by the accountant review. The approved review reference identifies the decision attached to the customer authorization. The personally signed request reference identifies the authorization attached to the credit.

## Ordering basis
Primary quantity reconciliation precedes accounting review because the review consumes its per-node quantity. Review precedes customer authorization because the customer must be shown the authoritative corrected amount. Authorization precedes the invoice credit because this route requires the customer personally to authorize the exact remaining overcharge. All source exports exist before the call; calculations, customer filing and account posting execute synchronously without waiting.

## Roles in the procedure
The agent owns the quantity assessment, accountant review and credit posting. The customer themselves owns the personal filing.

## Ordering case
Hypothetical reversal of adjacent responsibilities: if customer authorization preceded the accountant review, the authoritative corrected amount would not yet be available to show the customer. If credit posting preceded personal authorization, the required personal authority for the exact remaining overcharge would be missing.
