title: Object Storage: activation
content:
Object Storage activation is governed by the following clauses.

The contract status is applied. The contract approval status is approved. Activate an approved application after provisioning evidence confirms the configured resources; record activated at from the current handling clock. Refuse rejected or pending applications. Setup is invoiced under lifecycle and bank-return fee basis when setup fee is positive; a waived setup fee creates no charge. Repeating an activation of an already active contract is a read-only confirmation, not another activation.

For contract state, the pre-action authority is the system record, using storage contract reference, status. The evidence must correlate storage contract reference for the proposed action. The contract status is applied.

For provisioning approval, the pre-action authority is the system record, using storage contract reference, approval status. The evidence must correlate storage contract reference for the proposed action. The contract approval status is approved.

## Basis Q&A

What is the applicable opening condition? The contract status is applied.

title: Object Storage: admission
content:
Object Storage admission is governed by the following clauses.

The signed application request has an approved service review. The customer signs and submits the application through an authorized channels channel. Create status applied and opened date from the current handling clock, with no consumption or charge. The requested tier supplies resource count limit; reject unsupported regions, unsupported currency, resource counts above that limit, and unapproved contract terms without a write. The customer owns the signature; an agent cannot sign for them. Entry gates are evaluated against the authoritative signed application fields copied into the proposed holding.

For signed approval, the pre-action authority is the system record, using storage business event reference, customer request reference, status, decision. The evidence must correlate storage business event reference together with customer request reference for the proposed action. The signed application request has an approved service review.

## Basis Q&A

What is the applicable opening condition? The signed application request has an approved service review.

title: Object Storage: multi holding
content:
Object Storage multi holding is governed by the following clauses.

The signed resource scope is not already represented by a nonclosed contract. Multiple independent resource scopes may be held. Use external business reference as the signed resource-scope key. Count all nonclosed holdings of this category for the same customer; refuse creation if the count would exceed maximum concurrent customer contracts. A repeated signed application with the same external resource scope reuses the existing contract rather than opening another. The maximum is 24 nonclosed contracts per customer.

For scope unique, the pre-action authority is the system record, using storage contract reference, customer reference, status, external business reference. The evidence must correlate storage contract reference together with customer reference for the proposed action. The signed resource scope is not already represented by a nonclosed contract.

## Basis Q&A

What is the applicable opening condition? The signed resource scope is not already represented by a nonclosed contract.

## Hypothetical contract limit

Assume the customer already has 24 nonclosed Object Storage contracts. A new independent scope would exceed the permitted count and creation is refused. Repeating an existing signed scope instead reuses its existing contract.

title: Object Storage: usage
content:
Object Storage usage is governed by the following clauses.

Use pre-discount portfolio primary usage subtotal to select the portfolio discount. Combine only holdings of this category owned by the same customer with the same legal billing entity and source period, even if some have since closed. No cross-entity or cross-category spending counts. The threshold comparison is inclusive. Portfolio discount applies only to primary service usage and only if no higher-priority price applies; it is neither a cash credit nor a deduction from ancillary service fees.

The source period, a UTC calendar month; customer and legal billing entity match the proposed charge. Sum posted primary meter quantities net of meter reversal by holding, multiply each interval by its applicable standard tier standard primary unit rate and region factor without any discount or tax, and sum across this category. Exclude ancillary meters and never sum already discounted invoices.

## Basis Q&A

What is the applicable opening condition? Use pre-discount portfolio primary usage subtotal to select the portfolio discount.

title: Object Storage: amendment
content:
Object Storage amendment is governed by the following clauses.

The contract status is active or suspended. The source amendment request is approved and customer-authorized. The customer files a signed amendment request before the agent applies the approved attributes. The request external business reference identifies the signed amendment; its related approved review carries the affected exact values and effective service interval start. Request and review events preserve those effective attributes. Keep status unchanged, use the new tier only for service intervals beginning at the request effective time, and retain old tier and effective price on earlier meter and invoice records. Refuse any change above resource count limit or when completed amendments in the handling UTC month has reached monthly amendment limit. Completed amendment requests count once; pending, rejected or cancelled requests do not change the holding. Signed commitments keep their recorded expiration and remaining contractual liability unless the signed amendment explicitly replaces them.

For contract state, the pre-action authority is the system record, using storage contract reference, status. The evidence must correlate storage contract reference for the proposed action. The contract status is active or suspended.

For amendment approved, the pre-action authority is the system record, using storage business event reference, status, customer request reference, source business subtype. The evidence must correlate storage business event reference together with customer request reference for the proposed action. The source amendment request is approved and customer-authorized.

UTC calendar month containing the current handling time. Count completed request events of source business subtype amendment for this holding; cancelled and rejected requests do not count.

## Basis Q&A

What is the applicable opening condition? The contract status is active or suspended.

title: Object Storage: category meters
content:
Object Storage category meters is governed by the following clauses.

The tier plan capacity gb is a pricing-band reference, not free storage or a hard capacity cap. Primary hot-class quantity is actual GB-month at standard primary unit rate. cool-class storage and archive-class storage use cool-class storage unit rate and archive storage rate. PUT, COPY and LIST requests and GET requests use put request rate and get request rate per thousand operations; preserve the export quantity unit thousand operations and do not treat it as raw operations. cool retrieval, archive retrieval and expedited retrieval use their correspondingly named rates per GB; a retrieval has exactly one class and urgency, so these rates never stack. replication and Internet egress use replication rate and egress rate per GB. For cool-class early deletion or archive-class early deletion, compute the positive remaining calendar dates as the corresponding minimum-days parameter less authoritative object age in UTC calendar dates, multiply object GB by that remainder divided by actual calendar dates in the deletion month, and use the corresponding storage rate. Equality with minimum retention incurs no early-deletion charge. object age in UTC calendar dates counts UTC date changes from the object creation record to the deletion record; retention is attached to each object version, not its containing bucket. Replicated and versioned copies are distinct source object references and are metered independently. For every ancillary meter, multiply the nonincluded measured quantity by its selected rate, then round the net line using the tier monetary precision and the tier rounding convention and tax under tax calculation basis. An allowance is consumed chronologically by service interval start then original source reference within the named holding and UTC period; reversal of its source returns only that source allocation. Source subtype supplemental identifies these amounts so the primary discount policy does not apply. unknown meter codes or units are outside policy coverage instead of guessed prices. These calculations never authorize an unapproved customer-only action. For included capacities denominated in GB-month, contact-month or package-month, prorate the capacity by actual active interval seconds divided by actual seconds in its UTC month before comparing measured quantity. Category-specific primary inclusions replace the generic included monthly primary quantity where expressly named; they are not added twice. A mandatory minimum fee is a pricing minimum, not a second charge.

The following former handling clause is **no longer in force**: Completed service records prove nonfinancial entitlements;

## Basis Q&A

What is the applicable opening condition? The tier plan capacity gb is a pricing-band reference, not free storage or a hard capacity cap.

## Hypothetical retention case

Assume a retained object reaches exactly its applicable minimum retention on deletion. No calendar dates remain and no early-deletion charge arises. If the same hypothetical object were deleted one UTC calendar date earlier, the remaining retention is one date, measured against the actual number of calendar dates in its deletion month.

title: Object Storage: collection
content:
Object Storage collection is governed by the following clauses.

The bank record confirms the remittance as completed. Record only a bank-confirmed remittance using a payment methods rail and the amount actually received in currency. Customer consent to dispose of funds belongs to the customer; the agent only allocates a payment already confirmed by the bank. Apply an explicitly referenced invoice first; if the remittance omits allocation, use collection order, sorting invoice issue time then original source reference within the same customer and billing entity. Split across exact source invoice lines, never across legal billing entities. Each allocation is a separate negative payment amount linked to its original charge; any residual is an unallocated overpayment linked to the remittance reference. A repeated remittance reference and allocation target returns the existing posting. No receipt is inferred from a customer promise, and rejected or pending payments make no posting.

For confirmed payment, the pre-action authority is the system record, using storage business event reference, status, external business reference, method. The evidence must correlate storage business event reference for the proposed action. The bank record confirms the remittance as completed.

All posted financial events through the current handling time. Sum signed amount for charge, debit adjustment, payment return and refund together with negative amount for payment and credit, grouped by holding. No independently writable balance is stored..

## Basis Q&A

What is the applicable opening condition? The bank record confirms the remittance as completed.

title: Object Storage: combination
content:
Object Storage combination is governed by the following clauses.

An approved negotiated rate is a contract-specific override; the presence of a paid support holding makes assisted negotiated-amendment intake available through support as well as portal and api. Without that combination the signed amendment is submitted through portal or api. A promotional primary-price entitlement is suppressed wherever a commitment price covers the same quantity, and no benefit from an unrelated category is stacked.

The following former handling clause is **no longer in force**: A current Northbridge Enterprise Support holding for the same customer and billing entity provides assisted invoice explanation, but does not itself reduce this category price or waive debt.

The following former handling clause is **no longer in force**: The combination changes only request-channel eligibility, not approval authority.

## Basis Q&A

What is the applicable opening condition? An approved negotiated rate is a contract-specific override; the presence of a paid support holding makes assisted negotiated-amendment intake available through support as well as portal and api.

title: Object Storage: correction
content:
Object Storage correction is governed by the following clauses.

For source business subtype correction, the source charge has an approved review with decision incorrect. This gate is inapplicable to other source business subtype values. Correct an erroneous charge to the approved review net amount plus tax amount, following tax calculation basis. Compare that corrected gross amount with the source original gross amount less cumulative correction credits plus cumulative debit adjustments; do not include service-credit concessions in this correction comparison. A credit amount is negative and its net and tax components preserve the source proportions except an approved tax correction. An upward correction carries positive amount. Return the existing adjustment when the reviewed target has already been achieved. No cash refund is implicit in an invoice correction. Link original source reference to the original charge and supporting evidence reference to the approved review, never to a broad invoice containing several lines. Use net cumulative gross correction magnitude from exact-source credit totals for the correction comparison; prior pretax service concession magnitude never changes the approved corrected billing target.

The following former handling clause is **no longer in force**: Credit the positive overcharge, debit the positive undercharge, and make no write when equal.

For approved correction, the pre-action authority is the system record, using storage business event reference, original source reference, supporting evidence reference, status, decision. The evidence must correlate storage business event reference together with original source reference together with supporting evidence reference for the proposed action. For source business subtype correction, the source charge has an approved review with decision incorrect. This gate is inapplicable to other source business subtype values.

All posted credit and debit adjustment events through the current handling time for the exact original source reference. For the exact original charge original source reference, report net cumulative gross correction magnitude as absolute correction credit amount less debit-adjustment amount, and prior pretax service concession magnitude as absolute pretax net amount of service-credit postings. Keep these two named components separate; tax is included only in net cumulative gross correction magnitude, and unrelated source charges never enter either component.

## Basis Q&A

What is the applicable opening condition? For source business subtype correction, the source charge has an approved review with decision incorrect.

## Hypothetical source separation

Assume a service concession and a correction concern the same invoice line. The concession contributes to the pretax service-credit component but does not change the corrected billing target or enter the gross correction comparison.

title: Object Storage: fees
content:
Object Storage fees is governed by the following clauses.

This fee branch applies only to setup, resumption, termination and return fee source business subtype. Charge setup fee once for an activated holding, resumption fee per distinct completed restoration, termination fee for on-demand exit, and failed payment fee per completed bank return. An unexpired commitment exit instead bills the recorded remaining commitment liability in USD as its termination liability. Copy the exact source transition, customer authorization or bank notice reference; do not use a primary meter as fee evidence. A zero fee is waived without a financial event. The fee amount is the selected policy amount or recorded signed liability, rounded using the tier monetary precision and the tier rounding convention, then taxed under tax calculation basis. The primary-usage branch of primary usage pricing basis and its posted primary source meter gate apply only to source business subtype primary; supplemental charges use the category meter policy. Already billed source occurrence and fee subtype make repetition read-only.

## Basis Q&A

What is the applicable opening condition? This fee branch applies only to setup, resumption, termination and return fee source business subtype.

title: Object Storage: incident
content:
Object Storage incident is governed by the following clauses.

Operations record the closed incident, affected holding, exact incident external business reference, official incident closure time, cause, measured duration hours and availability percent from the official operational report. No customer statement substitutes for the report. Scheduled maintenance, customer changes and upstream-customer events remain visible with their cause code even though outage credit basis excludes them. Incident registration itself never creates a credit or changes contract status.

## Basis Q&A

What is the applicable opening condition? Operations record the closed incident, affected holding, exact incident external business reference, official incident closure time, cause, measured duration hours and availability percent from the official operational report.

title: Object Storage: invoice
content:
Object Storage invoice is governed by the following clauses.

No posted charge exists for the same source event, meter, source subtype, pricing component and billing period. Group service charges by invoice grouping. Billing periods follow billing cycle in billing timezone, beginning at the first instant of the first date and ending exclusively at the first instant of the next month. For measured usage, invoice only services whose interval has ended; lifecycle fees instead require their source occurrence to be completed; use the posted authoritative source records. Set invoice issue time to the current handling time. Carry forward a positive grouped subtotal below minimum invoice amount rather than issuing an invoice; zero-rated usage stays visible as a meter and receives no monetary charge. A source charge already posted for the same source event, meter, quantity component and invoice period is returned without another charge. The fixed source reference and source business subtype distinguish primary, supplemental, setup, termination, resumption and return-fee components.

For unbilled source component, the pre-action authority is the system record, using storage business event reference, original source reference, meter code, source business subtype, effective price branch, period, event type, status. The evidence must correlate original source reference for the proposed action. No posted charge exists for the same source event, meter, source subtype, pricing component and billing period.

## Basis Q&A

What is the applicable opening condition? No posted charge exists for the same source event, meter, source subtype, pricing component and billing period.

title: Object Storage: meter
content:
Object Storage meter is governed by the following clauses.

The authoritative export confirms the resource interval and the measured quantity. Meters originate in the provider resource export. Primary meter quantities use usage unit; a meter is positive and a meter reversal is the negative of the exact erroneous source quantity, capped by the source quantity not already reversed. Keep original interval, region, configuration and source reference. billing actual usage overage permits measured quantities above included monthly primary quantity; no service entitlement is invented by a meter write. Round measured quantities to the tier meter quantity precision using the tier rounding convention, apply minimum quantity and round positive billable primary quantities upward to a whole meter quantum. Stopped or suspended service accrues no primary running usage, but real retained storage and other supplemental services remain billable through supplemental meter. A rejected or cancelled source is not a billable meter. Repeated exports with the same resource, meter, interval and correction reference are read-only confirmations.

For export evidence, the pre-action authority is the system record, using storage business event reference, external business reference, service interval start, service interval end, quantity. The evidence must correlate storage business event reference for the proposed action. The authoritative export confirms the resource interval and the measured quantity.

## Basis Q&A

What is the applicable opening condition? The authoritative export confirms the resource interval and the measured quantity.

title: Object Storage: pricing
content:
Object Storage pricing is governed by the following clauses.

This policy and its gate apply only to primary usage source business subtype; category-specific primary pricing overrides expressly stated in category meter pricing basis take priority. For source business subtype primary, the source meter is posted and identifies the billed resource interval. This gate is inapplicable to other source business subtype values. Use the tier recorded for each source service interval. Read standard primary unit rate and region factors for primary usage. Allocate included monthly primary quantity across primary meter sources of the same holding and period in service interval start then original source reference order; prorate it by actual active UTC seconds divided by actual seconds in that UTC calendar month. Only the positive quantity beyond the remaining included allowance is charged. Allocate committed monthly primary quantity in that same order, splitting covered and uncovered primary quantities into distinguishable invoice lines. The holding commitment must cover the entire source interval to receive reservation discounts; a boundary-crossing interval is split at the recorded commitment boundary. For every quantity component choose the first applicable item in discount priority: an approved negotiated rate when negotiated rate allowed, then the committed fraction, then a recorded eligible promotion from promotion channels, then portfolio eligibility, then standard. The negotiated rate replaces the primary standard primary unit rate before applying the region factor and receives no further discount. Promotions and reservations are mutually exclusive. Round the final service subtotal using the tier monetary precision and the tier rounding convention after quantity multiplication, then apply tax calculation basis. No discount applies to taxes, license fees, standalone supplemental services or previously issued credits. Record effective price branch for each split quantity branch; it is part of the invoice-line identity. Do not apply a billing-period portfolio discount to a partial source interval before the full source period is closed.

For posted primary source meter, the pre-action authority is the system record, using storage business event reference, status, service interval start, service interval end. The evidence must correlate storage business event reference for the proposed action. For source business subtype primary, the source meter is posted and identifies the billed resource interval. This gate is inapplicable to other source business subtype values.

## Basis Q&A

What is the applicable opening condition? This policy and its gate apply only to primary usage source business subtype; category-specific primary pricing overrides expressly stated in category meter pricing basis take priority.

## Hypothetical price selection

Assume an approved permitted negotiated price and a promotion both cover the same primary quantity. The negotiated price replaces the standard primary rate before the region adjustment, and the promotion contributes no additional discount to that quantity.

title: Object Storage: refund
content:
Object Storage refund is governed by the following clauses.

The customer-authorized refund request and completed original payment refer to the same holding and source payment. The customer files an exact refund authorization; the agent refunds a confirmed overpayment only to the method and destination of its original payment. A requested amount exceeding that limit is refused, not silently reduced. Use refund methods, require at least refund minimum, and record a positive receivable delta for cash paid out. A smaller positive balance remains on account. Refunds require no active service contract and remain possible after closure. Repetition of the same request and source payment returns the existing refund. A third-party destination or unconfirmed payment is refused.

The following former handling clause is **no longer in force**: Available refund is the smaller of the negative net receivable magnitude and original payment principal less prior returns and refunds linked to that payment.

For refund consent, the pre-action authority is the system record, using storage business event reference, customer request reference, original source reference, status, storage contract reference. The evidence must correlate storage business event reference together with customer request reference together with original source reference together with storage contract reference for the proposed action. The customer-authorized refund request and completed original payment refer to the same holding and source payment.

## Basis Q&A

What is the applicable opening condition? The customer-authorized refund request and completed original payment refer to the same holding and source payment.

## Hypothetical authorization boundary

Assume the applicable refund limit is a hypothetical USD 42. An exact request for USD 43 is refused; it is not converted to a USD 42 payout.

title: Object Storage: request
content:
Object Storage request is governed by the following clauses.

Only the customer may file or cancel an authorization, claim or disposal request. Preserve the exact external business reference and the narrowest original source reference. An unsupported channel is refused. A repeated identical request reference returns the existing event. Filing a request never confirms a system approval or changes an accounting balance.

The following former handling clause is **no longer in force**: Set notice filing time and recorded occurrence time to the current handling clock and status pending on filing; cancellation is a new request event with status cancelled linked to the original request.

## Basis Q&A

What is the applicable opening condition? Only the customer may file or cancel an authorization, claim or disposal request.

title: Object Storage: return
content:
Object Storage return is governed by the following clauses.

The completed bank return notice refers to the exact original posted payment. The bank return must identify the exact posted payment. Restore the returned principal as a positive amount, up to the original payment amount not already returned. Copy its method, customer, billing entity and currency. A partial return uses the distinct bank notice external business reference. A duplicate bank notice produces no new write. Any failed payment fee is a separately identifiable return-fee charge under lifecycle and bank-return fee basis, never hidden in returned principal; a waived fee produces no fee posting.

For bank return, the pre-action authority is the system record, using storage business event reference, original source reference, status, external business reference. The evidence must correlate storage business event reference together with original source reference for the proposed action. The completed bank return notice refers to the exact original posted payment.

## Basis Q&A

What is the applicable opening condition? The completed bank return notice refers to the exact original posted payment.

title: Object Storage: review
content:
Object Storage review is governed by the following clauses.

The source event and the evidence record identify the same holding and narrowest business object. A service accountant reviews one precise source event against its authoritative export, contract terms, bank notice, tax record or incident record. Record decision correct or incorrect for a billing review, and eligible or ineligible for an outage claim; status approved means the review is complete and authoritative, not that a credit necessarily follows. A rejected review cannot authorize money movement. The customer may provide a locator but cannot dictate an official decision. Repeating the same source and request review returns the existing decision; materially new evidence is a distinct review linked through supporting evidence reference. Review alone books no money.

The following former handling clause is **no longer in force**: Record corrected net amount and tax amount for incorrect billing, or claimed or approved credit amount for an eligible outage after applying outage credit basis.

For reviewable source, the pre-action authority is the system record, using storage business event reference, original source reference, supporting evidence reference, storage contract reference. The evidence must correlate storage business event reference together with original source reference together with supporting evidence reference together with storage contract reference for the proposed action. The source event and the evidence record identify the same holding and narrowest business object.

## Basis Q&A

What is the applicable opening condition? The source event and the evidence record identify the same holding and narrowest business object.

title: Object Storage: service concession
content:
Object Storage service concession is governed by the following clauses.

For a service concession financial posting, an approved review has decision eligible and positive claimed or approved credit amount for the exact source charge; this gate does not constrain filing or reviewing the request. For a service concession request being filed, the outage claim is filed no later than credit claim days after the official incident closes. For a newly filed claim, current handling time is its notice filing time; the request is recorded immediately. Later review and credit use that recorded notice filing time to evaluate the same boundary, so a timely request does not expire while awaiting review. Add credit claim days UTC calendar dates to official incident closure time, preserving its time of day; calendar dates are counted without substituting business days or elapsed-hour periods. Equality at the deadline qualifies; a later claim is rejected without a credit. The provider incident must be completed, with cause outside outage exclusions. Availability at or above availability target percentage gives no credit. Below the target choose the first descending descending availability credit bands entry whose minimum is no greater than the recorded availability percent. Floor the additional credit at zero and round with the tier monetary precision and the tier rounding convention. Apply the original tax component proportionately. A review writes its nonnegative approved result; a financial credit writes the negative approved amount only after that approved review exists. This service-credit branch applies only to source business subtype service concession; billing correction basis applies only to source business subtype correction. Excluded incidents, ineligible reviews and zero remaining entitlement result in no financial write. A request for consequential-loss compensation is not covered. A service-credit financial posting requires an approved review with decision eligible and positive claimed or approved credit amount; the request and incident alone cannot authorize the financial posting.

The following former handling clause is **no longer in force**: Multiply the original source charge net amount by that fraction; subtract the prior pretax service concession magnitude component of prior credits for that exact source, and cap total service credits at cumulative outage credit cap fraction of that original net amount.

For claim deadline, the pre-action authority is the system record, using storage business event reference, official incident closure time, notice filing time. The evidence must correlate storage business event reference for the proposed action. For a service concession request being filed, the outage claim is filed no later than credit claim days after the official incident closes.

For approved service credit, the pre-action authority is the system record, using storage business event reference, original source reference, status, decision, claimed or approved credit amount. The evidence must correlate original source reference for the proposed action. For a service concession financial posting, an approved review has decision eligible and positive claimed or approved credit amount for the exact source charge; this gate does not constrain filing or reviewing the request.

## Basis Q&A

What is the applicable opening condition? For a service concession financial posting, an approved review has decision eligible and positive claimed or approved credit amount for the exact source charge; this gate does not constrain filing or reviewing the request.

## Hypothetical filing boundary

Assume an otherwise qualifying claim. A filing at the incident closure time advanced by the tier claim period in UTC calendar dates is timely. A filing immediately after that boundary is late. Reviewing a timely recorded claim after the boundary does not change its original timely filing.

title: Object Storage: tax
content:
Object Storage tax is governed by the following clauses.

The applicable tax classification has an approved system review. Use the source contract tax treatment reviewed at the service date and tax rates. Apply tax to the final rounded net service amount; round tax separately using the tier monetary precision and the tier rounding convention. For a correction or credit use the original charge tax basis unless an approved tax-error review supplies the corrected treatment. Tax credits have negative tax amount; charges and upward adjustments have positive tax amount. Unsupported tax jurisdictions are outside policy coverage, not assumed exempt. Sum net subtotal and signed tax to obtain the financial amount. A verified exemption overrides the ordinary taxable rate; there is no stacking of tax treatments.

For tax evidence, the pre-action authority is the system record, using storage contract reference, tax review status, tax treatment. The evidence must correlate storage contract reference for the proposed action. The applicable tax classification has an approved system review.

## Basis Q&A

What is the applicable opening condition? The applicable tax classification has an approved system review.

## Hypothetical tax example

Assume a final rounded service amount of USD 17.25 and an applicable hypothetical tax fraction of 0.08. Multiplication yields USD 1.38 tax; the gross financial amount is USD 18.63. The tax acts on the rounded service amount.

title: Object Storage: exit
content:
Object Storage exit is governed by the following clauses.

The customer has filed the exact resource-disposal authorization for this contract. Only the customer may withdraw an application or terminate their provisioned resources. An applied contract can be withdrawn without any setup, usage or termination charge. For active or suspended contracts, record closed date from the current handling clock and stop running primary meters at the exact customer-confirmed close time. Accrued usage and actual retained-resource charges remain payable; closing never erases receivables or credits. termination fee applies to an on-demand exit under lifecycle and bank-return fee basis. If a signed commitment remains unexpired and commitment cancel allowed is false, invoice its recorded remaining commitment liability in USD as a distinct termination component, without also charging future usage against that same liability. No new usage begins after closure; existing financial corrections, collection and refunds remain possible. Repeating the same closed-resource confirmation has no further effect. Before closing, the signed termination schedule supplies remaining commitment liability in USD and is zero when no unbilled commitment liability remains. A positive recorded liability necessarily triggers the distinct termination charge using the disposal request as its original source reference; closure and that one invoice entry complete the event chain.

For customer disposal, the pre-action authority is the system record, using storage contract reference, customer request reference, original source reference. The evidence must correlate storage contract reference together with customer request reference together with original source reference for the proposed action. The customer has filed the exact resource-disposal authorization for this contract.

## Basis Q&A

What is the applicable opening condition? The customer has filed the exact resource-disposal authorization for this contract.

title: Object Storage: resumption
content:
Object Storage resumption is governed by the following clauses.

The contract status is suspended. The contract official payment restriction state is clear. Restore a suspended holding after its official payment restriction clears; no customer promise substitutes for recorded clearance. Set status active. Bill resumption fee under lifecycle and bank-return fee basis only when positive, and preserve retained-resource history. A contract already active needs no write; a closed contract requires a new signed application and cannot be resumed.

For contract state, the pre-action authority is the system record, using storage contract reference, status. The evidence must correlate storage contract reference for the proposed action. The contract status is suspended.

For restriction cleared, the pre-action authority is the system record, using storage contract reference, official payment restriction state. The evidence must correlate storage contract reference for the proposed action. The contract official payment restriction state is clear.

## Basis Q&A

What is the applicable opening condition? The contract status is suspended.

title: Object Storage: suspension
content:
Object Storage suspension is governed by the following clauses.

The contract status is active. Collection suspension occurs no earlier than invoice due days plus suspension grace days after the source invoice is issued. The contract official payment restriction state is restricted and the source invoice retains unpaid principal. Add invoice due days and then suspension grace days UTC calendar dates to invoice issue time, preserving its time of day; do not use business days or replace the anchor with contract activation. Equality qualifies. The source overdue invoice must retain a positive unpaid principal; a fully paid invoice cannot justify suspension. Earlier handling sends an informational explanation without a status change. An agent suspends active service only when official payment restriction state is restricted; ordinary billing disputes alone do not suspend service. Retained ancillary resources can still produce actual supplemental usage. Repeated handling of an already suspended contract makes no new transition.

For contract state, the pre-action authority is the system record, using storage contract reference, status. The evidence must correlate storage contract reference for the proposed action. The contract status is active.

For collection deadline, the pre-action authority is the system record, using storage business event reference, invoice issue time. The evidence must correlate storage business event reference for the proposed action. Collection suspension occurs no earlier than invoice due days plus suspension grace days after the source invoice is issued.

For collection restriction, the pre-action authority is the system record, using storage contract reference, official payment restriction state, storage business event reference, amount. The evidence must correlate storage contract reference together with storage business event reference for the proposed action. The contract official payment restriction state is restricted and the source invoice retains unpaid principal.

## Basis Q&A

What is the applicable opening condition? The contract status is active.

## Hypothetical boundary cases

Assume the source invoice still has unpaid principal, the contract is active, and the official restriction is recorded. At the deadline obtained by adding the invoice due period and then the collection grace period to the invoice issue time, suspension qualifies. Immediately before that deadline, handling gives an informational explanation and leaves status unchanged.

title: Object Storage: capacity entitlement handling
content:
Object Storage capacity entitlement is handled on request. Record a quantified shared-capacity entitlement for one storage source charge. The agent completes the selected entitlement with its GB-month quantity; the completed entitlement is visible immediately and the receipt confirms success.

## Invocation

record_capacity_entitlement_88579e54. This is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call) by the agent.

## Parameters

- storage_event_id: Id class — Identifier of the Storage entitlement reference copied from find_storage_events. This is the capacity entitlement input.
- quantity: Fixed-format class — Unit GB-month; schema format Decimal quantity to six decimal places. Entitled GB-month quantity as a decimal number with six decimal places; round half-up before submission, stored at six decimal places; empty is not allowed. This is the capacity entitlement input.

## Successful return

A string reading Entitlement completed with the storage entitlement reference and recorded GB-month quantity; completed confirms the entitlement is available.

title: Object Storage: capacity entitlement — metered cool-storage quantity
content:
For Object Storage capacity entitlement, for a cool-storage correction, sum quantity of completed supplemental cool-class storage meters for the holding, the period of the source charge, and the source charge identified by original source reference of the authorization selected by the holding customer request reference. Add the signed quantity of posted meter reversals for that same source charge and period. Floor the sum of metered and reversal-adjusted quantity at zero.

## Basis Q&A

What determines capacity entitlement in this situation? For a cool-storage correction, sum quantity of completed supplemental cool-class storage meters for the holding, the period of the source charge, and the source charge identified by original source reference of the authorization selected by the holding customer request reference. Add the signed quantity of posted meter reversals for that same source charge and period. Floor the sum of metered and reversal-adjusted quantity at zero.

## Hypothetical capacity entitlement — metered cool-storage quantity case

For this capacity entitlement — metered cool-storage quantity example, assume hypothetical completed source-period cool storage of 160 GB-month and posted reversals with signed quantity negative 45 GB-month. Billable quantity is 115 GB-month. If reversal magnitude exceeds metered quantity, the chargeable result is floored at zero.

title: Object Storage: capacity entitlement — backup capacity eligibility
content:
For Object Storage capacity entitlement, read committed monthly primary quantity from the active backup contract with the same customer and legal billing entity, using zero when absent; this is the joint capacity ceiling in GB-month. When storage official payment restriction state is restricted the joint capacity ceiling is zero instead.

## Basis Q&A

What determines capacity entitlement in this situation? Read committed monthly primary quantity from the active backup contract with the same customer and legal billing entity, using zero when absent; this is the joint capacity ceiling in GB-month. When storage official payment restriction state is restricted the joint capacity ceiling is zero instead.

## Hypothetical capacity entitlement — backup capacity eligibility case

For this capacity entitlement — backup capacity eligibility example, assume a hypothetical matching active backup contract with committed monthly quantity 240 GB-month. With clear storage payment restrictions, the ceiling is 240 GB-month; with restricted storage payment status, it is zero. If the matching active backup contract is absent, it is also zero.

title: Object Storage: capacity entitlement — unused shared capacity
content:
For Object Storage capacity entitlement, subtract previously consumed included quantity on completed storage service records for that exact source and period from the shared capacity ceiling. Floor the residual shared capacity at zero. A clear storage official payment restriction state permits the residual shared capacity; a restricted official payment restriction state permits zero.

## Basis Q&A

What determines capacity entitlement in this situation? Subtract previously consumed included quantity on completed storage service records for that exact source and period from the shared capacity ceiling. Floor the residual shared capacity at zero. A clear storage official payment restriction state permits the residual shared capacity; a restricted official payment restriction state permits zero.

title: Object Storage: capacity entitlement — recorded outcome
content:
For Object Storage capacity entitlement, record the smaller of the calculated billable quantity and eligible remaining capacity, rounded half-up only at the outcome to the tier meter quantity precision decimal places in GB-month.

## Basis Q&A

What determines capacity entitlement in this situation? Record the smaller of the calculated billable quantity and eligible remaining capacity, rounded half-up only at the outcome to the tier meter quantity precision decimal places in GB-month.

## Hypothetical capacity entitlement amount

Assume hypothetical chargeable volume of 115 GB-month and permitted residual inclusion of 80 GB-month. The recorded volume is 80 GB-month, with rounding applied only to that final volume.

title: Object Storage: capacity entitlement — application boundary
content: Object Storage capacity entitlement has the following application boundary. For the cool-storage correction branch, a completed service record grants the calculated shared backup capacity as a nonfinancial storage allowance for its exact source charge. Record exactly one approved entitlement by changing the pending entitlement record to completed, copying its existing source charge reference; do not create a duplicate entitlement.

title: Object Storage: cool credit handling
content:
Object Storage cool credit is handled on request. Post one signed correction credit against a storage source charge. The agent records an immediately visible receivable reduction with its original charge and approved review references, and the posted receipt confirms success.

## Invocation

post_storage_correction_02018d1e. This is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call) by the agent.

## Parameters

- storage_event_id: Id class — Identifier of the Approved billing review reference copied from find_storage_events or a completed review receipt. This is the cool credit input.
- storage_holding_id: Id class — Identifier of the Storage contract reference copied from find_storage_holdings. This is the cool credit input.
- source_event_id: Id class — Identifier of the Original storage charge reference copied from find_storage_events. This is the cool credit input.
- related_event_id: Id class — Identifier of the Approved billing review reference copied from find_storage_events or the review completion receipt. This is the cool credit input.
- customer_id: Id class — Identifier of the Enterprise profile reference copied from find_customers. This is the cool credit input.
- amount: Fixed-format class — Unit USD; format USD to two decimals. Signed receivable reduction in USD, decimal number with two decimal places, half-up rounded before submission and stored at two decimals; empty is not allowed. This is the cool credit input.

## Successful return

A string reading Correction posted with the correction event reference and signed USD amount; posted confirms the receivable reduction is recorded.

title: Object Storage: cool credit — source invoice basis
content:
For Object Storage cool credit, read the amount of the posted source charge identified by initial source reference of the authorization selected by the holding customer request reference. Add signed amounts of all posted correction credits for that exact source charge; exclude service-credit concessions. Add signed amounts of all posted correction debit adjustments for that exact source charge.

## Basis Q&A

What determines cool credit in this situation? Read the amount of the posted source charge identified by initial source reference of the authorization selected by the holding customer request reference. Add signed amounts of all posted correction credits for that exact source charge; exclude service-credit concessions. Add signed amounts of all posted correction debit adjustments for that exact source charge.

title: Object Storage: cool credit — approved correction evidence
content:
For Object Storage cool credit,  Sum net amount of approved incorrect billing reviews for that exact source charge; the branch admits exactly one current review and no superseded review.

## Basis Q&A

What determines cool credit in this situation?  Sum net amount of approved incorrect billing reviews for that exact source charge; the branch admits exactly one current review and no superseded review.

title: Object Storage: cool credit — backup capacity eligibility
content:
For Object Storage cool credit, read committed monthly primary quantity from the active backup contract with the same customer and legal billing entity, using zero when absent; this is the joint capacity ceiling in GB-month. When storage official payment restriction state is restricted the joint capacity ceiling is zero instead.

## Basis Q&A

What determines cool credit in this situation? Read committed monthly primary quantity from the active backup contract with the same customer and legal billing entity, using zero when absent; this is the joint capacity ceiling in GB-month. When storage official payment restriction state is restricted the joint capacity ceiling is zero instead.

## Hypothetical cool credit — backup capacity eligibility case

For this cool credit — backup capacity eligibility example, assume a hypothetical matching active backup contract with committed monthly quantity 240 GB-month. With clear storage payment restrictions, the ceiling is 240 GB-month; with restricted storage payment status, it is zero. If the matching active backup contract is absent, it is also zero.

title: Object Storage: cool credit — cool-storage pricing
content:
For Object Storage cool credit, use the storage tier cool-class storage unit unit price in USD per GB-month. Multiply the shared volume ceiling by the cool-storage unit price and round the resulting maximum correction net amount half-up to the tier monetary precision.

## Basis Q&A

What determines cool credit in this situation? Use the storage tier cool-class storage unit unit price in USD per GB-month. Multiply the shared volume ceiling by the cool-storage unit price and round the resulting maximum correction net amount half-up to the tier monetary precision.

## Hypothetical cool credit — cool-storage pricing case

For this cool credit — cool-storage pricing example, assume a hypothetical volume ceiling of 125 GB-month and a hypothetical cool-storage unit price of USD 0.0136 per GB-month. Their product is USD 1.70 before final rounding of the correction ceiling.

title: Object Storage: cool credit — remaining overcharge
content:
For Object Storage cool credit, subtract the approved corrected net target from the original amount plus signed prior correction credits and debits, then floor at zero.

## Basis Q&A

title: Object Storage: outage concession and cash return
content:
Object Storage A customer seeks return of excess cash on an untaxed storage invoice with a completed provider incident and one completed original payment. The terminal state contains the adjudicated service concession and the customer-authorized original-destination refund.

## Ordered business actions

1. The customer themselves performs the customer claim amount action using file_storage_outage_claim_6a92fd5d.
2. The agent performs the accountant approved concession action using assess_storage_outage_30bc4acc.
3. The agent performs the signed concession credit action using post_storage_service_concession_cfd2170f.
4. The customer themselves performs the customer exact refund authorization action using authorize_storage_refund_9b3e6afe.
5. The agent performs the cash refund action using refund_storage_overpayment_1b2c5ab5.

## Object continuity

The filed claim reference is the assessment request reference. The approved assessment reference becomes the concession supporting evidence reference. The posted concession reference becomes the authorization supporting evidence reference. The exact authorization request reference becomes the payout authorization reference.

## Ordering basis

The customer claim is the basis of the accountant assessment; an unfiled claim supplies no claimed amount. The approved assessment is the basis of the financial concession; an unapproved result supplies no money authority. The concession must be posted before its resulting cash balance can be authorized. The exact customer authorization must exist before its cash payout. Each action is a synchronous filing, accountant calculation or financial booking against a completed report or payment; no physical or external event is manufactured.

## Hypothetical swapped actions

If the financial concession were placed before the approved assessment, that financial action would lack the assessment that supplies money authority. If payout preceded the exact authorization, it would lack customer authorization.

title: Enterprise Support: Activation evidence
content:
Enterprise Support — Activation evidence.

## Policy clauses

The contract status is applied.

The contract approval status is approved.

Activate an approved application after provisioning evidence confirms the configured resources; record activation time from the current handling time.

Refuse rejected or pending applications.

Setup is invoiced under lifecycle fee accounting when setup fee is positive; a waived setup fee creates no charge.

Repeating an activation of an already active contract is a read-only confirmation, not another activation.

## Authoritative evidence

The contract status is applied. The authoritative system record must establish the condition before the action. Its evidence comprises support contract reference, status. Correlate the action to the same support contract reference.

The contract approval status is approved. The authoritative system record must establish the condition before the action. Its evidence comprises support contract reference, approval status. Correlate the action to the same support contract reference.

title: Enterprise Support: Signed application admission
content:
Enterprise Support — Signed application admission.

## Policy clauses

The signed application request has an approved service review.

The customer signs and submits the application through an authorized channels channel.

Create status applied and opening date from the current handling time, with no consumption or charge.

The requested tier supplies max resources; reject unsupported regions, unsupported currency, resource counts above that limit, and unapproved contract terms without a write.

The customer owns the signature; an agent cannot sign for them.

Entry gates are evaluated against the authoritative signed application fields copied into the proposed holding.

## Authoritative evidence

The signed application request has an approved service review. The authoritative system record must establish the condition before the action. Its evidence comprises support event reference, request reference, status, decision. Correlate the action to the same support event reference, request reference.

title: Enterprise Support: Independent signed resource scopes
content:
Enterprise Support — Independent signed resource scopes.

## Policy clauses

The signed resource scope is not already represented by a nonclosed contract.

Multiple independent resource scopes may be held.

Use external reference as the signed resource-scope key.

Count all nonclosed holdings of this category for the same customer; refuse creation if the count would exceed maximum simultaneous contracts per customer of 24.

A repeated signed application with the same external resource scope reuses the existing contract rather than opening another.

## Authoritative evidence

The signed resource scope is not already represented by a nonclosed contract. The authoritative system record must establish the condition before the action. Its evidence comprises support contract reference, customer reference, status, external reference. Correlate the action to the same support contract reference, customer reference.

## Hypothetical case

A hypothetical customer already holding 24 nonclosed independent scopes cannot open a further scope. Repeating one signed scope reuses its existing contract.

title: Enterprise Support: Portfolio usage eligibility
content:
Enterprise Support — Portfolio usage eligibility.

## Policy clauses

Use eligible portfolio usage subtotal to select the portfolio discount.

Combine only holdings of this category owned by the same customer with the same legal billing entity and source period, even if some have since closed.

No cross-entity or cross-category spending counts.

The threshold comparison is inclusive.

Portfolio discount applies only to primary service usage and only if no higher-priority price applies; it is neither a cash credit nor a deduction from ancillary service fees.

## Measurement basis

The source period, a UTC calendar month; customer and legal billing entity match the proposed charge. Sum posted primary meter quantities net of consumption reversal by holding, multiply each interval by its applicable standard tier standard primary unit rate and region factor without any discount or tax, and sum across this category. Exclude ancillary meters and never sum already discounted invoices.

title: Enterprise Support: Signed contract amendments
content:
Enterprise Support — Signed contract amendments.

## Policy clauses

The contract status is active or suspended.

The source amendment request is approved and customer-authorized.

The customer files a signed amendment request before the agent applies the approved attributes.

The request external reference identifies the signed amendment; its related approved review carries the affected exact values and effective inclusive service start.

Request and review events preserve those effective attributes.

Keep status unchanged, use the new tier only for service intervals beginning at the request effective time, and retain old tier and effective price on earlier meter and invoice records.

Refuse any change above max resources or when completed amendments in the handling UTC month has reached amendment limit.

Completed amendment requests count once; pending, rejected or cancelled requests do not change the holding.

Signed commitments keep their recorded expiration and remaining contractual liability unless the signed amendment explicitly replaces them.

## Authoritative evidence

The contract status is active or suspended. The authoritative system record must establish the condition before the action. Its evidence comprises support contract reference, status. Correlate the action to the same support contract reference.

The source amendment request is approved and customer-authorized. The authoritative system record must establish the condition before the action. Its evidence comprises support event reference, status, request reference, source subtype. Correlate the action to the same support event reference, request reference.

## Measurement basis

UTC calendar month containing the current handling time. Count completed request events of source subtype amendment for this holding; cancelled and rejected requests do not count.
