title: Enterprise Support: Corrected-fee assessment
content:
Enterprise Support — Corrected-fee assessment.

## Action

An accountant can complete this arithmetic billing review synchronously from already official exports and signed rates. An incorrect source bill receives an approved review with decision incorrect, corrected pretax net amount, zero signed tax amount, and equivalent vCPU-hour quantity.

title: Enterprise Support: Supplemental baseline export hours for corrected-fee assessment
content:
Enterprise Support — Supplemental baseline export hours for corrected-fee assessment.

## Decision basis

For corrected-fee assessment: Sum completed supplemental support spending export quantity, in vCPU-hours, for the same original charge and period; primary missing-export records and rejected records do not enter this baseline.

## Hypothetical case

For corrected-fee assessment: Suppose two hypothetical qualifying records for the specified source and service period contain quantities of 12 and 8 in the stated unit. Their contribution totals 20. A record for another source or period does not enter that total.

title: Enterprise Support: Compute campaign selection for corrected-fee assessment
content:
Enterprise Support — Compute campaign selection for corrected-fee assessment.

## Decision basis

For corrected-fee assessment: For these on-demand compute export reconstructions, an approved negotiated rate receives no further discount; otherwise an eligible compute promotion reduces the compute price by that compute tier promotion discount, and an absent or expired promotion gives zero discount.

## Points of judgment

For corrected-fee assessment: A negotiated compute price receives no campaign reduction. Without an approved negotiated price, an eligible compute campaign supplies its tier reduction; an absent or expired campaign supplies zero.

title: Enterprise Support: Compute contract price evidence for corrected-fee assessment
content:
Enterprise Support — Compute contract price evidence for corrected-fee assessment.

## Decision basis

For corrected-fee assessment: Select the same-customer active compute contract with the same legal billing entity; use its authorized signed negotiated unit rate, otherwise its tier standard primary unit rate. If there is no matching compute contract, the reconstructed compute rate is zero and no compute-spend contribution is recognized.

For corrected-fee assessment: This reconstruction values actual exported compute usage; it does not grant a support discount.

## Points of judgment

For corrected-fee assessment: An authorized negotiated price on the matching active compute contract supplies the selected price; otherwise the selected price comes from that contract’s tier. The matching contract belongs to the same customer and legal billing entity.

title: Enterprise Support: Handling conditions for corrected-fee assessment
content:
Enterprise Support — Handling conditions for corrected-fee assessment.

## Handling condition

For corrected-fee assessment: Before completing the corrected support-fee review, the missing compute-spend export for its original source charge must have a posted primary support meter.

title: Enterprise Support: Discounted charge and minimum order for corrected-charge assessment
content:
Enterprise Support — Discounted charge and minimum order for corrected-charge assessment.

## Decision basis

For corrected-charge assessment: Multiply eligible spending by the support charge fraction and then by one minus the single support discount; apply the full-month minimum to that discounted subtotal.

## Hypothetical case

For corrected-charge assessment: Suppose eligible spending is hypothetically USD 1000, the support fraction is 20 percent, the selected discount is 25 percent, and the monthly minimum is USD 175. The percentage subtotal is USD 200, the discounted subtotal is USD 150, and the charge floor yields USD 175. Applying the discount to the minimum instead would not follow this rule.

title: Enterprise Support: Effective compute unit price for corrected-fee assessment
content:
Enterprise Support — Effective compute unit price for corrected-fee assessment.

## Decision basis

For corrected-fee assessment: Multiply the selected compute unit price once by one minus its applicable compute discount to obtain the effective cloud rate; all source intervals in this reconciliation use US East and on-demand standard configuration.

## Hypothetical case

For corrected-fee assessment: A hypothetical selected compute unit price of USD 0.80 and applicable discount of 25 percent yield an effective price of USD 0.60 per vCPU-hour. The reduction acts once on the selected unit price.

title: Enterprise Support: Disjoint export spending addition for corrected-fee assessment
content:
Enterprise Support — Disjoint export spending addition for corrected-fee assessment.

## Decision basis

For corrected-fee assessment: Add the posted recognized eligible supported spending in USD amount to baseline vCPU-hours multiplied by the effective cloud rate; these are disjoint provider export buckets.

## Hypothetical case

For corrected-fee assessment: Suppose recognized spending is hypothetically USD 70 and the disjoint baseline has 100 vCPU-hours at an effective cloud rate of USD 0.40. Baseline spending is USD 40 and eligible spending is USD 110. The recognized USD 70 is already monetary and is not multiplied by the cloud rate again.

title: Enterprise Support: outcome precision and disposition for corrected-fee assessment
content:
Enterprise Support — outcome precision and disposition for corrected-fee assessment.

## Decision basis

For corrected-fee assessment: Round the final nonnegative reviewed net support fee half up to two decimal places; the selected source tax treatment is US untaxed and reviewed signed tax amount is zero.

## Hypothetical case

For corrected-fee assessment: A hypothetical reviewed net fee of USD 123.455 rounds half up to USD 123.46. The reviewed tax is zero.

title: Enterprise Support: Invoice and service month selection for corrected-fee assessment
content:
Enterprise Support — Invoice and service month selection for corrected-fee assessment.

## Decision basis

For corrected-fee assessment: The latest billing review by recorded occurrence time identifies the precise original underlying charge and its service month.

## Hypothetical case

For corrected-fee assessment: Suppose two hypothetical billing reviews have different recorded occurrence times and identify different original charges. The later review supplies both the underlying charge and its service month; the earlier review’s month is not substituted.

title: Enterprise Support: Monthly support lower bound boundary for corrected-fee assessment
content:
Enterprise Support — Monthly support lower bound boundary for corrected-fee assessment.

## Decision basis

For corrected-fee assessment: The full-month support lower bound monthly support fee remains the last floor after applying the support fee fraction and its single selected discount.

title: Enterprise Support: posted eligible source spending for corrected-fee assessment
content:
Enterprise Support — posted eligible source spending for corrected-fee assessment.

## Decision basis

For corrected-fee assessment: Sum posted primary support consumption entries quantity for the exact original source charge and service period; reversed or unrelated periods are excluded.

## Hypothetical case

For corrected-fee assessment: Suppose two hypothetical qualifying records for the specified source and service period contain quantities of 12 and 8 in the stated unit. Their contribution totals 20. A record for another source or period does not enter that total.

title: Enterprise Support: Support campaign selection for corrected-fee assessment
content:
Enterprise Support — Support campaign selection for corrected-fee assessment.

## Decision basis

For corrected-fee assessment: An approved negotiated support fraction takes no additional discount regardless of portfolio spending; otherwise, within the on-demand reconciliation branch without an applicable portfolio discount, apply eligible support promotion discount, or zero for an absent or expired promotion.

## Points of judgment

For corrected-fee assessment: The approved negotiated support fraction takes no further discount even when portfolio spending is present. In the stated on-demand branch without an applicable portfolio discount, the non-negotiated price uses an eligible support campaign reduction; absent or expired campaigns give zero.

title: Enterprise Support: Support fee fraction for corrected-fee assessment
content:
Enterprise Support — Support fee fraction for corrected-fee assessment.

## Decision basis

For corrected-fee assessment: Use the support contract approved negotiated fee fraction when present, otherwise its tier standard primary unit rate.

title: Enterprise Support: Support service and ancillary meters
content:
Enterprise Support — Support service and ancillary meters.

## Policy clauses

The selected reference monthly supported-spend band is the plan reference, not an included monetary credit.

Primary eligible supported spending in USD quantity is eligible pre-tax cloud service spending net of correction credits, grouped by legal billing entity and month; service-credit concessions, support fees, taxes and cash remittances are excluded.

marketplace included decides whether marketplace lines enter that base.

Charge the greater of minimum monthly support fee and eligible eligible supported spending in USD times the effective standard primary unit rate after the ordinary non-stacked discount selection, prorating the minimum by actual active seconds in the UTC month for partial-month service.

An approved annual support-spend commitment uses reservation discounts for its covered spend; a promotion, portfolio discount or negotiated percentage instead follows primary usage pricing priority.

No discount reduces the minimum monthly support fee, which remains the last floor applied to the monthly net fee.

The source commitment is a signed support-spend obligation, never an infrastructure reservation borrowed from a different category.

named contacts bills contacts above included contacts at additional contact fee per contact-month.

architecture reviews bills completed reviews above included reviews at extra review fee.

onsite days bills authorized delivered consultant-days at onsite day fee.

Record measured first-response times against critical response minutes, high response minutes and normal response hours using incident-created UTC time to first human response elapsed time; these are service targets, not extra usage fees.

dedicated manager controls whether a named technical account manager can be assigned; without entitlement the assignment is refused and there is no substitute charge.

Service records records these entitlements and actual delivery, never an invented cash credit for a missed response.

For every ancillary meter, multiply the nonincluded measured quantity by its selected rate, then round the net line using monetary decimal precision and rounding convention and tax under service tax accounting.

An allowance is consumed chronologically by inclusive service start then original source reference within the named holding and UTC period; reversal of its source returns only that source allocation.

Source subtype supplemental identifies these amounts so the primary discount policy does not apply.

Completed service records prove nonfinancial entitlements; unknown meter codes or units are outside the covered policy instead of guessed prices.

These calculations never authorize an unapproved customer-only action.

For included capacities denominated in GB-month, contact-month or package-month, prorate the capacity by actual active interval seconds divided by actual seconds in its UTC month before comparing measured quantity.

Category-specific primary inclusions replace the generic included quantity where expressly named; they are not added twice.

A mandatory minimum fee is a pricing minimum, not a second charge.

## Hypothetical case

Suppose a hypothetical monthly percentage calculation yields USD 80 and its applicable prorated minimum is USD 100. The net fee is USD 100; the minimum is not an additional USD 100 charge. A hypothetical percentage result of USD 130 remains USD 130.

title: Enterprise Support: Bank-confirmed payment allocation
content:
Enterprise Support — Bank-confirmed payment allocation.

## Policy clauses

The bank record confirms the remittance as completed.

Record only a bank-confirmed remittance using a payment methods rail and the amount actually received in currency.

Customer consent to dispose of funds belongs to the customer; the agent only allocates a payment already confirmed by the bank.

Apply an explicitly referenced invoice first; if the remittance omits allocation, use collection order, sorting invoice issue time then original source reference within the same customer and billing entity.

Split across exact source invoice lines, never across legal billing entities.

Each allocation is a separate negative payment amount linked to its original charge; any residual is an unallocated overpayment linked to the remittance reference.

A repeated remittance reference and allocation target returns the existing posting.

No receipt is inferred from a customer promise, and rejected or pending payments make no posting.

## Authoritative evidence

The bank record confirms the remittance as completed. The authoritative system record must establish the condition before the action. Its evidence comprises support event reference, status, external reference, method. Correlate the action to the same support event reference.

## Measurement basis

All posted financial events through the current handling time. Sum signed amount for charge, debit adjustment, payment return and refund together with negative amount for payment and credit, grouped by holding.

title: Enterprise Support: Assisted amendment intake
content:
Enterprise Support — Assisted amendment intake.

## Policy clauses

A same-customer active Northbridge Virtual Compute contract makes assisted support-plan amendment intake available through support; without it the signed amendment is submitted through portal or api.

This is a request-channel entitlement only and does not waive approved commercial terms.

Reservation and promotional discounts remain mutually exclusive for the same support-spend quantity as specified in primary usage pricing.

Other products do not provide included support contacts or a technical account manager.

title: Enterprise Support: Source-line invoice corrections
content:
Enterprise Support — Source-line invoice corrections.

## Policy clauses

For source subtype correction, the source charge has an approved review with decision incorrect.

This gate is inapplicable to other source subtype values.

Correct an erroneous charge to the approved review pretax net amount plus signed tax amount, following service tax accounting.

Compare that corrected gross amount with the source original gross amount less cumulative correction credits plus cumulative debit adjustments; do not include service-credit concessions in this correction comparison.

Credit the positive overcharge, debit the positive undercharge, and make no write when equal.

A credit amount is negative and its net and tax components preserve the source proportions except an approved tax correction.

An upward correction carries positive amount.

Return the existing adjustment when the reviewed target has already been achieved.

No cash refund is implicit in an invoice correction.

Link original source reference to the original charge and related evidence reference to the approved review, never to a broad invoice containing several lines.

Use gross correction component from separate source correction and service-credit totals for the correction comparison; net service-credit component never changes the approved corrected billing target.

## Authoritative evidence

For source subtype correction, the source charge has an approved review with decision incorrect. This gate is inapplicable to other source subtype values. The authoritative system record must establish the condition before the action. Its evidence comprises support event reference, original source reference, related evidence reference, status, decision. Correlate the action to the same support event reference, original source reference, related evidence reference.

## Measurement basis

All posted credit and debit adjustment events through the current handling time for the exact original source reference. For the exact original charge original source reference, report gross correction component as absolute correction credit amount less debit-adjustment amount, and net service-credit component as absolute pretax net amount of service-credit postings. Keep these two named components separate; tax is included only in gross correction component, and unrelated source charges never enter either component.

## Hypothetical case

Suppose a hypothetical source gross charge is USD 140, its correction credits total USD 20, and its debit adjustments total USD 5. Its corrected comparison base is USD 125. An approved gross target of USD 120 therefore calls for a USD 5 credit; an outage concession does not alter that comparison.

title: Enterprise Support: Lifecycle fee charges
content:
Enterprise Support — Lifecycle fee charges.

## Policy clauses

This fee branch applies only to setup, resumption, termination and returned-payment fee source subtype.

Charge setup fee once for an activated holding, resumption fee per distinct completed restoration, termination fee for on-demand exit, and failed payment fee per completed bank return.

An unexpired commitment exit instead bills the recorded remaining signed commitment liability in USD as its termination liability.

Copy the exact source transition, customer authorization or bank notice reference; do not use a primary meter as fee evidence.

A zero fee is waived without a financial event.

The fee amount is the selected policy amount or recorded signed liability, rounded using monetary decimal precision and rounding convention, then taxed under service tax accounting.

The primary-usage branch of primary usage pricing and its posted primary-meter condition gate apply only to source subtype primary; supplemental charges use the category meter policy.

Already billed source occurrence and fee subtype make repetition read-only.

title: Enterprise Support: Official incident registration
content:
Enterprise Support — Official incident registration.

## Policy clauses

Operations record the closed incident, affected holding, exact incident external reference, official incident closure time, cause, measured duration in hours and availability percentage from the official operational report.

No customer statement substitutes for the report.

Scheduled maintenance, customer changes and upstream-customer events remain visible with their cause code even though outage credit accounting excludes them.

Incident registration itself never creates a credit or changes contract status.

title: Enterprise Support: Invoice source identity
content:
Enterprise Support — Invoice source identity.

## Policy clauses

No posted charge exists for the same source event, meter, source subtype, pricing component and billing period.

Group service charges by invoice grouping.

Billing periods follow billing cycle in billing timezone, beginning at the first instant of the first date and ending exclusively at the first instant of the next month.

For measured usage, invoice only services whose interval has ended; lifecycle fees instead require their source occurrence to be completed; use the posted authoritative source records.

Set invoice issue time to the current handling time.

Carry forward a positive grouped subtotal below minimum invoice amount rather than issuing an invoice; zero-rated usage stays visible as a meter and receives no monetary charge.

A source charge already posted for the same source event, meter, quantity component and invoice period is returned without another charge.

The fixed source reference and source subtype distinguish primary, supplemental, setup, termination, resumption and return-fee components.

## Authoritative evidence

No posted charge exists for the same source event, meter, source subtype, pricing component and billing period. The authoritative system record must establish the condition before the action. Its evidence comprises support event reference, original source reference, meter code, source subtype, distinct price component, period, event type, status. Correlate the action to the same original source reference.

title: Enterprise Support: Provider consumption evidence
content:
Enterprise Support — Provider consumption evidence.

## Policy clauses

The authoritative export confirms the resource interval and the measured quantity.

Meters originate in the provider resource export.

Primary meter quantities use usage unit; a meter is positive and a consumption reversal is the negative of the exact erroneous source quantity, capped by the source quantity not already reversed.

Keep original interval, region, configuration and source reference.

billing of actual measured overage overage permits measured quantities above included quantity; no service entitlement is invented by a meter write.

Round measured quantities to meter quantity decimal precision using rounding convention, apply minimum quantity and round positive billable primary quantities upward to a whole meter quantum.

Stopped or suspended service accrues no primary running usage, but real retained storage and other supplemental services remain billable through supplemental consumption entry.

A rejected or cancelled source is not a billable meter.

Repeated exports with the same resource, meter, interval and correction reference are read-only confirmations.

## Authoritative evidence

The authoritative export confirms the resource interval and the measured quantity. The authoritative system record must establish the condition before the action. Its evidence comprises support event reference, external reference, inclusive service start, exclusive service end, quantity. Correlate the action to the same support event reference.

title: Enterprise Support: Primary usage pricing
content:
Enterprise Support — Primary usage pricing.

## Policy clauses

This policy and its gate apply only to primary usage source subtype; category-specific primary pricing overrides expressly stated in category-specific meter pricing take priority.

For source subtype primary, the source meter is posted and identifies the billed resource interval.

This gate is inapplicable to other source subtype values.

Use the tier recorded for each source service interval.

Read standard primary unit rate and region factors for primary usage.

Allocate included quantity across primary meter sources of the same holding and period in inclusive service start then original source reference order; prorate it by actual active UTC seconds divided by actual seconds in that UTC calendar month.

Only the positive quantity beyond the remaining included allowance is charged.

Allocate committed quantity in that same order, splitting covered and uncovered primary quantities into distinguishable invoice lines.

The holding commitment must cover the entire source interval to receive reservation discounts; a boundary-crossing interval is split at the recorded commitment boundary.

For every quantity component choose the first applicable item in discount priority: an approved negotiated rate when negotiated rate allowed, then the committed fraction, then a recorded eligible promotion from promotion channels, then portfolio eligibility, then standard.

The negotiated rate replaces the primary standard primary unit rate before applying the region factor and receives no further discount.

Promotions and reservations are mutually exclusive.

Round the final service subtotal using monetary decimal precision and rounding convention after quantity multiplication, then apply service tax accounting.

No discount applies to taxes, license fees, standalone supplemental services or previously issued credits.

Record distinct price component for each split quantity branch; it is part of the invoice-line identity.

Do not apply a billing-period portfolio discount to a partial source interval before the full source period is closed.

For support primary usage, standard primary unit rate and signed negotiated unit rate are USD charged per eligible eligible supported spending in USD, so the negotiated rate is the signed fee fraction.

Apply the category monthly minimum after this quantity calculation.

## Authoritative evidence

For source subtype primary, the source meter is posted and identifies the billed resource interval. This gate is inapplicable to other source subtype values. The authoritative system record must establish the condition before the action. Its evidence comprises support event reference, status, inclusive service start, exclusive service end. Correlate the action to the same support event reference.

## Hypothetical case

Suppose a hypothetical quantity component has an approved negotiated rate and an eligible promotion. The negotiated price replaces the standard rate before the regional adjustment; the promotion supplies no additional reduction.

title: Enterprise Support: Original-payment cash refunds
content:
Enterprise Support — Original-payment cash refunds.

## Policy clauses

The customer-authorized refund request and completed original payment refer to the same holding and source payment.

The customer files an exact refund authorization; the agent refunds a confirmed overpayment only to the method and destination of its original payment.

Available refund is the smaller of the negative net receivable magnitude and original payment principal less prior returns and refunds linked to that payment.

A requested amount exceeding that limit is refused, not silently reduced.

Use refund methods, require at least minimum voluntary cash refund, and record a positive receivable delta for cash paid out.

A smaller positive balance remains on account.

Refunds require no active service contract and remain possible after closure.

Repetition of the same request and source payment returns the existing refund.

A third-party destination or unconfirmed payment is refused.

## Authoritative evidence

The customer-authorized refund request and completed original payment refer to the same holding and source payment. The authoritative system record must establish the condition before the action. Its evidence comprises support event reference, request reference, original source reference, status, support contract reference. Correlate the action to the same support event reference, request reference, original source reference, support contract reference.

## Hypothetical case

Suppose a hypothetical negative receivable has magnitude USD 70 and remaining original payment principal is USD 45. The available limit is USD 45. A USD 50 request is refused rather than reduced to that limit.

title: Enterprise Support: Customer request registration
content:
Enterprise Support — Customer request registration.

## Policy clauses

Only the customer may file or cancel an authorization, claim or disposal request.

Preserve the exact external reference and the narrowest original source reference.

Set recorded notice time and recorded occurrence time to the current handling time and status pending on filing; cancellation is a new request event with status cancelled linked to the original request.

An unsupported channel is refused.

A repeated identical request reference returns the existing event.

Filing a request never confirms a system approval or changes an accounting balance.

title: Enterprise Support: Returned payment principal
content:
Enterprise Support — Returned payment principal.

## Policy clauses

The completed bank return notice refers to the exact original posted payment.

The bank return must identify the exact posted payment.

Restore the returned principal as a positive amount, up to the original payment amount not already returned.

Copy its method, customer, billing entity and currency.

A partial return uses the distinct bank notice external reference.

A duplicate bank notice produces no new write.

Any failed payment fee is a separately identifiable return-fee charge under lifecycle fee accounting, never hidden in returned principal; a waived fee produces no fee posting.

## Authoritative evidence

The completed bank return notice refers to the exact original posted payment. The authoritative system record must establish the condition before the action. Its evidence comprises support event reference, original source reference, status, external reference. Correlate the action to the same support event reference, original source reference.

title: Enterprise Support: Accountant source reviews
content:
Enterprise Support — Accountant source reviews.

## Policy clauses

The source event and the evidence record identify the same holding and narrowest business object.

A service accountant reviews one precise source event against its authoritative export, contract terms, bank notice, tax record or incident record.

Record decision correct or incorrect for a billing review, and eligible or ineligible for an outage claim; status approved means the review is complete and authoritative, not that a credit necessarily follows.

Record corrected pretax net amount and signed tax amount for incorrect billing, or approved credit amount for an eligible outage after applying outage credit accounting.

A rejected review cannot authorize money movement.

The customer may provide a locator but cannot dictate an official decision.

Repeating the same source and request review returns the existing decision; materially new evidence is a distinct review linked through related evidence reference.

Review alone books no money.

## Authoritative evidence

The source event and the evidence record identify the same holding and narrowest business object. The authoritative system record must establish the condition before the action. Its evidence comprises support event reference, original source reference, related evidence reference, support contract reference. Correlate the action to the same support event reference, original source reference, related evidence reference, support contract reference.

title: Enterprise Support: Outage claim credits
content:
Enterprise Support — Outage claim credits.

## Policy clauses

For an outage service credit financial posting, an approved review has decision eligible and positive approved credit amount for the exact source charge; this gate does not constrain filing or reviewing the request.

For an outage service credit request being filed, the outage claim is filed no later than credit claim days after the official incident closes.

For a newly filed claim, current handling time is its recorded notice time; the request is recorded immediately.

Later review and credit use that recorded notice time to evaluate the same boundary, so a timely request does not expire while awaiting review.

Add credit claim days UTC calendar dates to official incident closure time, preserving its time of day; calendar dates are counted without substituting business days or elapsed-hour periods.

Equality at the deadline qualifies; a later claim is rejected without a credit.

The provider incident must be completed, with cause outside outage exclusions.

Availability at or above availability target percentage gives no credit.

Below the target choose the first descending availability credit bands entry whose minimum is no greater than the recorded availability percentage.

Multiply the original source charge pretax net amount by that fraction; subtract the net service-credit component of prior credits for that exact source, and cap total service credits at credit cap fraction of that original net amount.

Floor the additional credit at zero and round with monetary decimal precision and rounding convention.

Apply the original tax component proportionately.

A review writes its nonnegative approved result; a financial credit writes the negative approved amount only after that approved review exists.

This service-credit branch applies only to source subtype outage service credit; invoice correction accounting applies only to source subtype correction.

Excluded incidents, ineligible reviews and zero remaining entitlement result in no financial write.

A request for consequential-loss compensation is not covered.

A service-credit financial posting requires an approved review with decision eligible and positive approved credit amount; the request and incident alone cannot authorize the financial posting.

## Authoritative evidence

For an outage service credit request being filed, the outage claim is filed no later than credit claim days after the official incident closes. The authoritative system record must establish the condition before the action. Its evidence comprises support event reference, official incident closure time, recorded notice time. Correlate the action to the same support event reference.

For an outage service credit financial posting, an approved review has decision eligible and positive approved credit amount for the exact source charge; this gate does not constrain filing or reviewing the request. The authoritative system record must establish the condition before the action. Its evidence comprises support event reference, original source reference, status, decision, approved credit amount. Correlate the action to the same original source reference.

## Hypothetical case

A hypothetical claim filed exactly at the official incident closure time advanced by the prescribed claim calendar dates satisfies the filing deadline. A claim filed one second later misses it. A later review uses the timely recorded notice time, so review delay does not make that claim late.

title: Enterprise Support: Retained-fee authorization
content:
Enterprise Support — Retained-fee authorization.

## Action

The customer may elect to retain one corrected source-month fee and personally authorize the resulting surplus refund to the original payment method. File one pending refund request of the refund subtype; preserve their exact external reference, source payment and original charge linkage. Its amount is the exact requested cash refund and creates no accounting posting.

## Reference contract

For this source invoice, file the request under exactly the customer-request reference reserved by the selected latest paid-invoice review, copied from the review receipt or retrieved review.

The customer submission creates the pending request with its authorization reference and request reference both equal to the reserved reference.

Possession of the reserved reference alone is not consent. Only the customer personally submitting the amount creates the authorization.

## Hypothetical reference case

Suppose a hypothetical paid-invoice review discloses a reserved reference. A customer filing under that exact reference creates the pending authorization; possession of the reference without the customer submission does not.

## Capability

File the customer's own authorization to return a specified support-payment surplus. A pending cash-refund request is created under the supplied reserved reference and records the chosen amount and the exact original payment and invoice; filing changes no accounting balance. Only this customer submission supplies consent; the reference reservation alone does not. Success returns the authorization reference and requested amount so the customer and desk can see what was submitted.

## Invocation

authorize_support_surplus_cef239e4 must first be unlocked (unlock) and handed over, to be run by the customer themselves.

## Parameters

- `customer_id`: Id class — enterprise customer reference number copied from the located profile.

- `support_holding_id`: Id class — support contract reference number copied from the retrieved payment.

- `source_event_id`: Id class — original completed payment reference number copied from support payment history.

- `support_event_id`: Id class — original support invoice-line reference number copied from that payment's source reference.

- `request_id`: Id class — reserved customer-request reference number copied from the paid-invoice review completion receipt or its request reference in support event lookup.

- `external_reference`: Verbatim class — use the request reference stated by the customer, copied character for character with original wording, digits and punctuation and without translation, normalisation, summarisation, addition or deletion (verbatim).

- `amount`: Fixed-format class — exact authorized cash refund, format USD to two decimals, unit USD; rounded half up before submission and stored at two-decimal precision.

## Return

A success string giving the authorization reference as a string and requested USD amount as a two-decimal number; 'Refund authorization filed' confirms the pending request was saved and supplies its reference for subsequent customer dialogue.

title: Enterprise Support: Cash-return limit for retained-fee authorization
content:
Enterprise Support — Cash-return limit for retained-fee authorization.

## Decision basis

For retained-fee authorization: The proposed amount refund is the smaller of the surplus after retained funding and the remaining original payment principal floored at zero. The selected refund request cannot exceed either the surplus after retained funding or the nonnegative remaining original payment principal.

## Hypothetical case

For retained-fee authorization: Suppose surplus after retained funding is hypothetically USD 210 and nonnegative remaining original principal is USD 150. The proposed amount refund is USD 150. If those hypothetical limits are reversed, the proposed amount is still USD 150.

title: Enterprise Support: Retained-fee cash return
content:
Enterprise Support — Retained-fee cash return.

## Action

Pay the exact customer-authorized amount only to the original recorded payment method and destination; the support balance retains one corrected source-month fee. The returned amount is a positive receivable delta.

## Reference contract

The selected customer authorization must use the customer-request reference reserved on the latest paid-invoice review for this source invoice.

For the refund action, the cash-disposal authorization reference and exact refund request reference must both be copied from that submitted request reference.

The earlier review receipt supplies the reference for handover and reconciliation. The actual customer submission supplies consent; a reservation without that submitted pending request is insufficient.

## Hypothetical reference case

Suppose a hypothetical review has reserved a request reference but no customer submission exists. That reservation is insufficient for a cash return. When the exact pending authorization has been submitted, its reference supplies both refund reference arguments.

## Capability

Execute an agent's support surplus refund against the original payment. One positive receivable entry records the returned cash, original payment method and customer's authorization, with the refund reference immediately visible. Success confirms the posted USD amount and the refund reference.

## Invocation

refund_support_surplus_235c4f6f is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call) by the agent.

## Parameters

- `customer_id`: Id class — enterprise customer reference number copied from the located profile.

- `support_holding_id`: Id class — support contract reference number copied from the customer's refund authorization.

- `support_event_id`: Id class — cash-disposal authorization reference number copied from the paid-review reserved request reference and confirmed by the customer's filing receipt.

- `method`: Enum class — allowed values are none (a noncash accounting record), ach (cash returned to the original ACH payment destination), wire (cash returned to the original wire payment destination), and card (cash returned to the original card payment destination).

A success string containing the created refund reference as a string and refunded USD amount as a two-decimal number; 'Support refund posted' confirms the cash return and receivable entry are saved.

title: Enterprise Support: Internal handling procedure for retained-fee refunds
content:
Enterprise Support — Internal handling procedure for retained-fee refunds.

## Procedure

A customer requests the surplus from a paid rate-error support invoice while retaining one corrected source-month fee on account; the outcome is a corrected bill and a source-payment refund with that retained balance.

## Ordered actions

1. The agent uses review_support_overcharge_b721fa46 to complete the numerical paid-invoice review from preexisting official evidence and signed terms. The same review update reserves and returns the customer-request reference; it creates no customer request and supplies no consent.

2. The agent uses credit_support_overcharge_7251caa0 to post the signed correction credit. This action uses the exact approved incorrect-billing review as its authorization reference.

3. The agent presents the calculated amount and hands over authorize_support_surplus_cef239e4. The customer themselves submits the authorization immediately under the previously disclosed reserved reference, creating the actual pending request.

4. The agent uses refund_support_surplus_235c4f6f to return the authorized amount by its original payment method. The actual customer filing receipt and exact submitted request reference supply the refund authorization.

## Ordering basis

The numerical review must precede the correction because only its approved incorrect decision authorizes the source credit. The credit must precede the customer authorization because its posted receivable delta changes the account surplus from which retained funding is deducted. Customer authorization must precede payment because only the customer may dispose of their funds; the refund consumes that exact authorization reference and amount. All actions are synchronous desk accounting or immediate customer authorization, without a bank-clearance wait.

## Reference flow

The request reference reserved by the paid-invoice review becomes the reference supplied to the customer filing. That filing supplies the actual authorization for the refund. A reserved reference alone never supplies consent.

## Synchronous handling

Official source invoices, exports, signed prices, approved tax treatment and completed bank remittances preexist. All steps complete at the same consultation time without later bank clearance, outside approval, service delivery or elapsed time. Reference reservation occurs inside the review; consent exists only after the customer submission.

## Review decision

The review remains an incorrect-billing decision. The eligible-outage-review gate does not apply to this correction-subtype posting.

## Hypothetical ordering case

If the correction were hypothetically placed before its numerical review, the required approved incorrect-billing decision would be absent. If the cash return preceded customer filing, the reserved reference would exist without the required customer consent.

title: Enterprise Support: Collection suspension timing
content:
Enterprise Support — Collection suspension timing.

## Policy clauses

The contract status is active.

Collection suspension occurs no earlier than invoice due days plus suspension grace days after the source invoice is issued.

The contract payment restriction status is restricted and the source invoice retains unpaid principal.

Add invoice due days and then suspension grace days UTC calendar dates to invoice issue time, preserving its time of day; do not use business days or replace the anchor with contract activation.

Equality qualifies.

The source overdue invoice must retain a positive unpaid principal; a fully paid invoice cannot justify suspension.

Earlier handling sends an informational explanation without a status change.

An agent suspends active service only when official payment restriction status is restricted; ordinary billing disputes alone do not suspend service.

Retained ancillary resources can still produce actual supplemental usage.

Repeated handling of an already suspended contract makes no new transition.

## Authoritative evidence

The contract status is active. The authoritative system record must establish the condition before the action. Its evidence comprises support contract reference, status. Correlate the action to the same support contract reference.

Collection suspension occurs no earlier than invoice due days plus suspension grace days after the source invoice is issued. The authoritative system record must establish the condition before the action. Its evidence comprises support event reference, invoice issue time. Correlate the action to the same support event reference.

The contract payment restriction status is restricted and the source invoice retains unpaid principal. The authoritative system record must establish the condition before the action. Its evidence comprises support contract reference, payment restriction status, support event reference, amount. Correlate the action to the same support contract reference, support event reference.

## Hypothetical case

For a hypothetical unpaid source invoice, handling exactly at its issue time advanced by the prescribed maturity and grace calendar dates satisfies the time gate. One second earlier does not and produces only the stated informational explanation. These cases address timing only; the recorded restriction and active-contract conditions still apply.
